tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅/ /yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa'i rnam par bshad pa gzhan phan kun khyab ces bya ba bzhugs so// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa'i rnam par bshad pa gzhan phan kun khyab ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed chos kun ji lta'i dbyings nyid du/ /ye shes mig gis rig nas thugs rje yis/ /lam mchog rnam par snang ba'i 'od mdzad pa/ /bla ma 'khor lo'i dbang phyug nyid la 'dud/ /gang thugs gnyis med dang po'i sangs rgyas mchog /'khor gyi tshul 'dzin gsang rgyud sdud mdzad pa/ /rdor sems kun bzang phyag na rdo rje sogs/ /mtshan mchog du mas spras la gus btud nas/ /dpal ldan ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud kyi don/ /rmad byung brgyud pa'i tshul lugs ji bzhin du/ /rang nyid dran pa gso zhing gzhan dag la'ang / /phan gdags ched du ci nus dbye bar bya/ /'di la don gnyis te/ bshad pa'i sngon du 'gro ba dang / bshad pa dngos so/ /dang po la lnga ste/ phyogs gar gtogs ngos bzung ba/ de 'jig rten du ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de la rgya bod du bshad srol ji ltar byung ba'i tshul/ de'i brjod bya ngos bzung ba/ bshad thabs kyi man ngag bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sngags don rnam gzigs las/ rnal 'byor spyod dang bya ba'i rgyud/ /de bzhin pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ bya ba dang / spyod pa dang / rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum las/ kha cig rgyud 'di bdag gi rnal 'byor mi gsal zhing / bri bskyed shin tu gsal bas na/ spyod pa'i rgyud yin no zhes zer ro/ /de ni mi 'thad de/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas bdag gi rnal 'byor gsal bar gsungs shing / spyod rgyud la yang bdag gi rnal 'byor gsal bas/ bdag gi rnal 'byor mi gsal ba de spyod rgyud yin pa'i shes byed du mi rung ba'i phyir ro/

/des bya rgyud yin pa yang khegs pas na rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin te/ tshe dpag med kyi skabs nas/ rdo rje sems pa'i gnas 'dug nas/ /thams cad zos te kun byas kyang / /'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na/ /snying rjer ldan pas smos ci dgos/ /zhes bde bas 'grub par gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'o na rtsa rgyud dang / bshad rgyud gang yin snyam na/ sru lung pas bshad rgyud dam/ phyung rgyud dam/ bsdus rgyud lta bu ma yin te rtsa rgyud rang rkyang pa yin pas/ 'di la rtsa rgyud dam rgyud rgyas pa gzhan log na med do zhes zer ba ni mi 'thad de/ de nyid bsdus pa las gzhan pa'i yo ga'i rgyud yin na/ de nyid bsdus pa rtsa rgyud du byed dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /bu ston gyis/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud la/ rtsa ba'i rgyud/ rgyud phyi ma/ phyi ma'i phyi ma/ bshad pa'i rgyud/ cha mthun pa'i rgyud/ 'phros pa'am yan lag gi rgyud dang drug las/ phyi ma yin te/ de nyid bsdus pa'i dum bu gnyis pa las/ ngan 'gro dgug cing sdig pa bral ba las 'phros nas/ ngan song sbyong ba'i thabs rgya cher bstan pas 'phros rgyud dam/ de nyid kyi rtsa ba'i lha phal cher dum bu dang po'i lha dang phal cher 'dra zhing / de'i cha shas su gyur pas yan lag gi rgyud ces gsungs so/ /bla ma rnams kyi bzhed pa la/ slob dpon padma lcags kyus/ rtsa rgyud shin tu zab cing rtogs dka'i don/ /bshad dang cha mthun rgyud kyis rnam phye ba/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa rgyud/ bshad rgyud/ cha mthun gyi rgyud dang gsum las/ 'di cha mthun gyi rgyud yin par bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpal sdom pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ nga ni 'di nas mi snang nas/ /lo ni brgya dang bcu gnyis na/ /bstan pa'i snying po dam pa zhig /lha gnas gsum du grags pa de/ /'dzam gling shar lho'i phyogs mtshams na/ /dpal zhes bya ba'i ri bo la/ /thugs rjes mthun pa'i byin rlabs kyis/

/rgyal po dza zhes bya ba la/ /lag na rdo rjes gnang bar byed/ /mi la skal ldan dam pa rnams/ /byang chub mchog tu 'grub 'gyur bas/ /de la rtag tu gus pas byos/ /zhes 'byung bas ston pa myang ngan las 'das nas lo brgya dang bcu gnyis te/ nyer brgyad na rgya gar shar lho'i phyogs/ grong khyer pa ti kirti zhes bya bar rgyal po rab gsal zla ba zhes bya ba byung / de la phyag na rdo rjes rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur te/ lha gnas gsum du grags pa de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud la sogs pa rnal 'byor gyi rgyud mtha' dag gnang nas/ de nas mi yul du dar ro/ /de nyid bsdus pa'i rgyud la lha gnas gsum du grags pa ni/ lha gnas dang po 'og min/ gnyis pa ri rab kyi rtse/ gsum pa bka' bsdu ba'i gnas lcang lo can dang gsum du grags pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa'i yul du grub chen kun snying gis mdzad pa'i 'grel pa stong phrag bcu gnyis pa yod par grags kyang bod du ma 'gyur zhing / ka ma dhe nus mdzad pa'i 'grel pa ni bod du 'gyur yang bla med du 'grel pa'i lugs so/ /bod du rgyud 'di rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su paṇḍi ta zhi ba snying po dang / lo tstsha ba sad mi mi bdun gyi dus su 'gyur nas/ phyis ral pa can gyi dus su ā tsarya rin chen mchog gis skad gsar bcad kyis bcos pa las/ dus phyis lotstsha ba gzhan gyis bcos pa ni med do/ /'di la me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs nas drag po'i sbyin sreg yod kyang sngon gyi rgyal blon rnams kyis/ sngags pas mngon spyod byas su dogs nas ma bsgyur ba yin no/ /zhes snga ma dag 'chad pa la/ rje btsun gyis lo tstsha ba phyi ma rnams kyis gzhan la 'gyur chad pa dag 'jug pa ltar 'di la yang 'jug par rigs pa las ma bcug pa'i phyir/ rgya dpe nyid la med do snyam du sems pa yin no zhes gsung / sru lung pas me ltar 'bar ba'i sbyin sreg gi skabs nas/

de nas khung bu gsum las rnam gcig ni zhes bshad pas/ mngon spyod ma gsungs pa ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang de nyid las/ rdo rje khro bo'i las dngos su/ /bsad pa yin par bshad mod kyi/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang rnams kyang / /de dag byed 'gyur gdon mi za/ /zhes las 'jam po dngos su bstan pas drag po shugs las shes pa la dgongs so zhes bzhed pa ni rmad du byung ba'i bshad par snang zhing / lugs snga ma'i sgrub byed du 'gro'o/ /'di la bod na 'grel par ming btags pa brgyad tsam snang yang / bod kyis sbyar ba las/ rgya gar nas 'gyur ba ni med gsung / de yang gzi brjid bshad pa zhes bya ba 'dis byas cha med pa cig dang / mdzes pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'khyin lo tsā ba dge tshul khyung grags kyis byas nas kun snying la kha 'phangs pa dang / de nyid snang ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'bring mtshams kyi sprag le chung bas byas nas kun snying la kha 'phangs pa dang / zangs dkar gyis byas pa'i 'bru 'bum mam/ nam mkha' dri med ces bya ba khong rang gis mdzad pa kha byang btab pa dang / rong zom chos kyi bzang pos byas pa'i 'grel pa dang / go ru pa lo tstsha bas byas nas kun snying la kha 'phangs pa 'dod 'jo'i ba bya ba dang / 'bru 'grel zhes bya ba mchan dkyus su bcug pa cig dang / rma rin chen mchog gis byas pa'i dris lan rgol ba mig tshar bya ba dang brgyad do/ /'o na bshad srol gang gi rjes su 'brang snyam na/ rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'i slob ma rgyal bu sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po dang / ye shes rdo rje dang / pradzñāsiddhi dang / rab 'byor bskyangs dang bzhi yin la kha cig swasti pha la dang bzhi yin gyi rab 'byor bskyangs kun snying gi slob brgyud yin zhes zer/ kha cig de gnyis ka ma yin gyi nyi ma'i snying po dang bzhi yin zhes zer ro/ /de bzhi char gyi slob ma kun dga' snying po ste/ 'di nyid 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/

yi ge ā ming bdag nyid che/ /ston pa'i bstan pa gces 'dzin byed/ /blo ldan yon tan kun gyis bkur/ /zhes lung bstan cing / grub thob brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i bstod pa las kyang / sgrol ma dkar mos byin gyis brlabs/ /rnal 'byor rgyud la 'grel bshad mdzad/ /kun dga' snying po zhes bya ba'i/ /bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod pa'i yon tan la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan no/ /de nas pradzñā wa la ti/ pradzñā boddhi/ mu tig ka ko sha/ dharmā pha la rnams las rim pa bzhin brgyud de/ dharmā pha la'i slob ma ni/ rje dī paṃ ka ra dang / lo tstsha ba rin chen bzang po'o/ /yang kha cig na re/ slob dpon chen po buddha gu hya zhes bya ba dngos grub brnyes pa'i slob dpon zhig gis/ de nyid bsdus pa dang / rdo rje rtse mo dang / dpal mchog dang po dang / ngan song sbyong ba'i rgyud dang / rtog pa thams cad bsdus pa dang lnga'i dbang dang gdams pa rnams 'jam dpal las dngos su thos nas/ yan lag med pa'i rdo rje sogs las rim pa bzhin brgyud de/ slob dpon shākya bshes gnyen zhes bya bas de nyid bsdus pa'i rgya cher bshad pa shlau ka stong phrag bcu gnyis pa ko sa la'i rgyan zhes bya ba mdzad/ yang sngar gyi slob dpon grub pa thob pa de dang ming mtshungs pa'i slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba zhes bya bas de nyid bsdus pa'i 'grel pa mdzad de/ de ltar na don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig la khas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po ste/ rnal 'byor rgyud la mkhas pa'i mi gsum du grags so zhes bzhed do/ /yang kun dga' snying po'i mched grogs slob dpon 'jam dpal grags pa zhes bya ba 'jam dpal gyi grub pa thob cing sku che ba'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa des/ dpal sbas bzang po la bshad/ des bram ze ye shes rdo rje la bshad/ des na lent+ra'i nub sgo ba shes rab 'byung gnas blo gros la bshad/

des bram ze bzhad pa'i rdo rje dang / padma ka ra dang / shraddha ka ra gsum la bshad/ phyi ma gnyis kyis lo chen la bshad do/ /yang slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhes bya bas/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs dang / sgeg pa'i rdo rje gnyis la bshad/ de la sgeg pa'i rdo rje gsang mtshan yin la/ mtshan dngos ni dpal ldan byang chub mchog gi skal ba dang ldan pa zhes grags shing rin po che'i gling du sgrub pa mdzad nas dngos grub brnyes pas nor bu gling pa zhes kyang grags/ mu stegs kyis gsod par brtsams pa'i tshe/ 'jam dpal du sprul nas gzugs sna tshogs su ston pa'i sna tshogs gzugs can zhes kyang grags/ thugs rjes gzhan la phan 'dogs pas nyi ma lta bu'i slob dpon zhes kyang grags so/ /slob dpon des sūrya sing ha/ des dharmā badzra dang mu drwa siddhi/ des de wa sha ra la bshad/ de la shīnti garbha dang / smṝ ti dzñā na ste slob ma gnyis so/ /de dag las bod du ji ltar brgyud na/ lo tstsha ba rin chen bzang po kha cher lan gsum du byon pa'i dang po la/ kha che'i mkhan po tsand+ra ha ri la 'jig rten snang byed kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs nas dbang bskur zhus/ phyis shraddha ka ra warma la/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor dang / mi bskyod pa gnyis dang / rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur zhus nas de dag gi bshad bka' yang gsan cing / 'ga' zhig bsgyur/ lan gnyis pa la paṇḍi ta padma ka ra warma dang / pradzñā ka ra warma gnyis la gtugs te yo ga'i gzhung 'grel 'ga' zhig bsgyur/ dpal mchog gi phreng chad gso bas/ dum bu dang po'i rgyud 'grel gnyis ka dag par bcos/ de yan chad kyi lo chen gyi slob ma rnams ni/ shraddha nas brgyud pa'i yo ga'i skor 'dzin pas phyag len kun dga' snying po'i lugs la byed kyang de nyid snang ba ma 'gyur bas/ bshad pa ko sa la'i rgyan gyi steng nas mdzad pas bsnyen pa'i skabs su 'khor los sgyur ba'i chas su zhugs/

snying kha'i bdag 'jug la bum pa 'cha'/ rnam snang la mi bzhi rgyab sprod lta bu byed pa sogs bshad pa dang / lag len yang mi mthun cing / bon po 'dul ba'i ched du dbyangs la sogs pa'i spros pa yang che bar grags so/ /lan gsum pa la paṇḍi ta sangs rgyas zhi ba zhes bya ba nor bu gling pa bde ba'i rdo rje'i slob mar grags shing 'ga' zhig de gnyis mtshan dngos dang / gsang mtshan gyi khyad par ma gtogs pa gcig yin par yang 'dod la/ paṇḍi ta de la kun snying gi lugs kyi lag len dang bshad pa gnyis ka zhus pas de nyid la thugs ches shing thugs rtsis che bar mdzad/ ces bu ston bzhed do/ /lo chen gyi sku tshe'i mjug tu rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paṇḍi ta dharma pha la mnga' ris su byon pa la rnal 'byor rgyud kyi skor gsan pas/ kun snying gi brgyud pa bzhi par 'dug cing de yi gdams pa ma nor bar byung ste mnyes skad do/ /sbyong rgyud la yang rgyud gong 'og 'khrugs bsdebs nas mdzad pa ma gtogs gzhan nas rgyas 'gebs pa mi mdzad/ bsnyen pa'i dus su cha lugs ji bzhin pa bum pa lhag gnas la rnam rgyal gcig po rdo rje'i glu ma gtogs pa rnams la dbyangs mi mdzad do/ /lo chen de la spyir slob ma mang yang thugs kyi sras mchog bzhi ste/ lo chung legs pa'i shes rab/ mang nang gi gur shing brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan/ grwa pa gzhon she/ skyi nor dzñā na dang bzhi las/ dang pos dharmā pha la'i lugs ma gsan/ sngar gyi shraddha dang / sangs rgyas zhi ba gnyis kyi lugs 'dzin/ gnyis pas dharmā pha la'i lugs gtso bor 'dzin/ gsum pas gnyis ka'i gung srong / bzhi pas phyis kyi gzhung srong 'o/ /yang gzhan du sbyangs shing der thug pa'i pu hrangs pa an ston grags rin/ rgya ye tshul/ gungs pa dge bshes/ mar yul pa dkon mchog brtsegs te bzhi'o/ /dbus gtsang na mar dar tshul ni/ lo chen gyi drung du 'gro ba la rgyang ro dpe dmar gyi rkyang po chos blo snga/

de nas shangs kyi sum ston ye 'bar/ de nas nyang ston lce zhar/ de nas spang kha 'dar chung gi pha gzhon nu rgya mtsho/ la stod kyi brag steng pa/ snur phyi ru'i dmar ston chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ mdog gle ston/ bal shākya rdo rje/ thang ston kong ka ba/ mdog gong ga ba rnams te/ de dag phal cher lo chen la thug pa tsam byas nas gtso bor lo chung gi drung du sbyangs te/ dbus gtsang gi sa cha smad phyogs su dar bas yo ga smad lugs su grags/ yang lo chen gyi slob ma brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ des mal gyo/ des rje sa skya pa la brgyud de/ sa cha stod du dar ba rnams la yo ga stod lugs su grags so/ /yang paṇḍi ta dharmā pha la nas/ jo bo rje/ go mi sgom chen/ skyi nor dzñā na/ rmyal pa nyi ma shes rab/ snur nyi ma 'od zer sogs nas brgyud pa la jo bo'i lugs sam/ rtsa snur 'dzim gsum nas brgyud pa zhes grags so/ /bshad srol de dang / brag steng pa nas brgyud pa de dang / lo chung nas dbus pa dge ser/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen rnams las rim pa bzhin brgyud pa'i bshad pa rnams la/ rtsing zhib bag re dang cho ga gong 'og mi mthun pa bag re ma gtogs/ phal cher ni 'dra ba nyid du snang zhes gsungs so/ /mdor na paṇḍi ta dharmā pha la'i lugs brag steng pa nas brgyud pa 'di la rje btsun rin po ches/ rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag gzhan phan spyi chings/ rgyud kyi sa bcad dang mchan gnyis/ lag tu blang ba'i rim pa gzhan phan 'od zer dang / gzhan phan nyer mkho gnyis te/ de dag gi rjes su 'brangs nas bshad par bya ba yin no/ /bzhi pa la gsum ste/ brjod bya'i dbye ba/ bsdu ba/ gsungs pa'i dgos pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor gtso bor gyur pa drug de bzhin gshegs pa la 'jig rten pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor drug ro sreg pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas pa gcig las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bzhi ste/

bcu bdun ni brjod bya'i gtso bo yin la/ dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang / kun rig dang shākya thub pas dpaṃng po byas nas ras la bri ba dang gsum du phye na so drug dang / sdom pas bzhi bcu zhe gcig tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /de la kun rig rtsa ba'i rgyud nas kun rig gi dkyil 'khor dang / ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor rgyas pa dang / ras bris dang las bzhi'i sbyin sreg bsdus pa tsam bstan/ rgyud phyi ma las shākya thub pa sku'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag na rdo rje thugs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi skabs nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis/ tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor nas de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dang / ro sbyong ba'i thab rgyas pa dang / las bzhi'i sbyin sreg gi cung zad gsal ba byed pa rnams ston/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i skabs nas de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dang sngar gyi ro sreg gsal bar byed pa ston no/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i skabs nas de nyid kyi dkyil 'khor dang las gsum gyi sbyin sreg gong gi de rnams gsal bar byed pa'i phyir rgyas par ston no/ /gnyis pa ni/ yang de dag thams cad kyi don bsdu na ting nge 'dzin gyi bsnyen pa dang / ras bris la brten te sgrub pa dang / rang dang gzhan gyi don gyi las la sbyar ba zhes bya ba gsum du yang gsungs pa yin no/ /yang de dag gi don bsdu na/ sngon du slob ma smin par bya ba dang / smin pa des dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab par bya ba dang / phyag rgya'i ye shes la bslab pa dang / mtshan ma thob nas rang dang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa zhes pa gsum du'ang bsdu ba yin no/ /yang de dag thams cad kyi don dgos pas bsdu na rang gi don dang gzhan gyi don gnyis su 'du la gzhan don la tshe dang ldan pa'i don bya ba dang / tshe 'das pa'i don bya ba gnyis kyis bsdus pa yin no/

/de dag thams cad bsdu na 'di ltar go bar bya ste/ brjod bya'i gtso bo ni dkyil 'khor drug gam bcu gnyis yin la/ ro sreg dang sbyin sreg gnyis ni de'i phrin las yin zhing / bzlas pa dang / dngos grub kyi ye shes dang / phyag rgya'i ye shes rnams ni de dag gi grogs su gyur pa yin no/ /de dag nyams su len na thog mar slob ma smin par byas la ting nge 'dzin gyi bsnyen pa bya zhing ras bris la brten nas bsgrubs te/ rang dang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa'i phrin las la sbyar na gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ji ltar 'dod pa 'grub cing / mthar thug gi 'bras bu sangs rgyas 'grub pa yin no zhes bya bar shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ thugs chos nyid las ma g.yos pa'i rtags su dkyil 'khor bstan la/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i rtags su sbyin sreg bstan no/ /de yang bden pa gnyis dang mi 'gal ba'i ched du dkyil 'khor la yang 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis gsungs/ dngos por mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa dang / thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa mtshon pa'i ched du/ ro sreg gi sbyin sreg dang / phrin las rnam bzhi'i sbyin sreg gnyis gsungs/ de dag gi go rim yang thugs chos nyid las ma g.yos kyang / rtsa ba byang chub kyi sems su 'dus pa'i rtags su rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de ltar byang chub kyi sems su 'dus kyang thugs rjes ngan song gi rgyu 'bras gzhom pa'i phyir shākya thub pa'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de ltar rgyu 'bras bcom yang glo bur gyi rkyen gyis 'chi bas de bzlog pa'i ched du phyag na rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ glo bur gyi rkyen gyis mi 'chi yang sngon gyi las kyis 'chi bas de bzlog pa'i ched du tshe dpag med kyi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ 'chi bdag bcom yang phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo nas don mdzad dgos pas 'khor los bsgyur ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/

'gro ba'i don mdzad kyang ma rungs pa 'dul dgos pas me ltar 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ ma rungs pa btul yang dngos por lta ba sun phyung dgos pas ro sreg gi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ de sun phyung yang thugs rjes chos nyid las ma g.yos pa'i rtags su zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ de ltar ma g.yos kyang 'gro ba'i don mdzad dgos pas rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ de ltar don mdzad kyang 'khor baṃ dbang du bsdu dgos pas dbang gi dkyil 'khor gsungs/ dbang du bsdus kyang ma rungs pa la mngon spyod kyi las dgos pas drag po'i sbyin sreg gsungs/ 'jig rten pa'i gnod pa rnams zhi zhing 'jig rten kyi phun sum tshogs par bsgrub pa'i phyir du 'jig rten pa'i dkyil 'khor drug gsungs la so so'i dgos pa ni gzhung nyid kyi steng du rtogs par bya'o/ /lnga pa rgyud bshad thabs kyi man ngag ni spyir rgyud 'chad tshul la 'grel chen dri med 'od kyis dus 'khor bsdus rgyud 'chad pa lta bu rgyud 'grel pas 'chad pa dang / gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs kyi gzhung phran rnams la brten nas gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud 'chad pa lta bu rgyud gzhung phran gyis 'chad pa dang / rgyud rgyud nyid kyis 'chad pa dang gsum yod pa las/ 'di ni phyi ma ste sa chog gzhan du kha 'phangs pa dang / sems dpa' bcu drug 'god par gsungs kyang / de'i zhal phyag ma gsungs pa rnams rgyud gzhan gyis kha bskang ba ma gtogs rgyud kyi dngos bstan la yod pa rnams ni brtag pa gong 'og 'khrug bsdebs nas nyams su blang ba yin gyis/ rgyud sde gzhan gyis rgyas bkab pa la sogs pa mi byed pa'i phyir ro/ /'khrugs ji ltar sdeb pa'i tshul ni 'og gzhung don gyi skabs su rtogs par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bshad pa dngos la gnyis te/ mtshan don gyi sgo nas mdor bstan/ gzhung don gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/

dang po mtshan bsgyur ba ni/ rgya gar skad du/ sarba durga ti ni/ bod skad du/ ngan song thams cad/ pa ri sho dha ni ni yongs su sbyong ba/ te dzo rā dzā ya ni/ gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ ta thā ga tā ya ni de bzhin gshegs pa/ a ra ha te ni dgra bcom pa/ saṃ myaka saṃ buddha ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ nā ma ni zhes bya ba/ kal pa ni brtags pa'o/ /gnyis pa mtshan bshad pa ni rje btsun gyis chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ji lta ba de bzhin du chud cing gzhan la ston nus pas byang sems dang / sbyin pa dang / shes rab dang / brtson 'grus bzhi ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas so/ /des spyir 'dod khams kyi lha/ bye brag tu yul sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal mthong ba slab pa'i gzhi bzung / dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / phyir mi ldog pas na rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'o/ /mdzod spu'i 'od zer gyis ngan song thams cad zil gyis gnon pas na gzi brjid kyi rgyal po/ brtag pa ni cho ga zhib mo'o zhes bzhed do/ /'bru 'grel las ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes te chos kyi sku'o/ /dgra bcom pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ yang dag par rdzogs pa ni so sor rtog pa'i ye shes te de gnyis ni longs sku/ sangs rgyas ni bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes te sprul sku'o/ /sku gsum po de'i phrin las ni/ rgyu ngan pa las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis 'bras bu khams gsum du song bas na ngan song ste/ 'khor ba thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'o/ /ji ltar na rgyu ting nge 'dzin gyis las nyon dang / 'bras bu 'od zer gyis sdug bsngal sbyong bas na gzi brjid do/ /rgyal po dang brtag pa ni sngar dang 'dra bar gsungs so/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/

/zhes pa ni lo tstsha bas bkod pa'i mchod brjod do/ /des na mtshan don gyis 'og nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i brjod bya mtha' dag bsdus pas na dbang po rnon pos mtshan don la brten nas kyang brjod bya mdor bsdus te rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ gleng gzhi dang / gleng bslang ba dang / rgyud kyi gzhung dngos dang / rjes su yi rang ba'o/ /dang po la drug chos dang / sdud pa po dang / dus dang / ston pa dang / gnas phun sum tshogs pa dang / 'khor dang ston pa'i che bas bzhugs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i rgyud kyi tshig don 'di skad ces pa ste/ sgro skur dang / dbri bsnan med ces pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje bdag gis sangs rgyas shākya thub pa las mngon sum du thos kyi/ gzhan las brgyud pa ma yin zhes pa'o/ /thos pa ni rna ba'i dbang po skyon med pas thos kyi/ sgom byung gis don mngon sum du gyur pa ni ma yin pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ dus gcig na zhes pa ste/ de la ston pa spyod lam gyi dus/ yang dag 'jog gi dus/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i dus/ chos 'chad pa'i dus dang bzhi las/ dus gcig chos 'chad pa'i dus su thos pa'o/ /de yang dus mtha'i skad cig ma gcig la gsungs par nus pas 'chad byed ston pa'i che ba/ de'i tshe phyag na rdo rjes khong du chud pas sdud byed 'khor gyi che ba/ dus gcig gi tshe 'di thos kyi gzhan du ni gzhan dag kyang thos so zhes pas/ sdud pa po thos pa che ba/ dus gcig gi tshe chos 'di 'byung gi gzhan gyi tshe ni mi 'byung zhes pas bshad bya chos kyi che ba dang bzhi bstan pa yin no/ /'di dag ni pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa dang thun mong du ston 'khor tha dad kyi dbang du byas pa yin gyi yang dag par na phun sum tshogs pa lnga ka yang ston pa nyid kyi ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa kho na yin gyi rgyud tha dad pa ni cung zad kyang med do/

/bzhi pa ni bcom ldan 'das zhes pa ste/ bdud bzhi bcom zhing dbang phyug gi yon tan drug dang ldan pas na bcom ldan te/ rdo rje rtse mo las/ nyon mongs las dang de bzhin skye/ /nyon mongs shes bya'i sgrib de bzhin/ /mi mthun phyogs kyi chos rnams gang / /de bcom pas na bcom ldan brjod/ /ces dang / saṃ bu ṭi las/ 'di lta ste/ dpal dang phun sum tshogs pa dang / grags pa dang / ye shes dang / dbang phyug dang / gzugs bzang ba dang / brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ yon tan drug gi skal ba dang ldan pa'o/ /zhes so/ /'o na bcom ldan 'das kyi sgra bshad la bzhi bcom drug ldan nor bar bshad pa dang 'gal lo snyam na/ de ni bcom pa dang ldan pa'i skad dod so sor bshad pa dgag pa yin gyi/ bha ga wān zhes pa'i tshig nyid bcom pa dang ldan pa gnyis ka la 'jug pas bdud bzhi bcom pas na bha ga wān/ dbang phyug gi yon tan drug dang ldan pas na bha ga wān zhes pa'i sgra skad/ dgag pa ma yin pas skyon med do/ /lnga pa la gnas dngos dang / de'i khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rdzu 'phrul yod cing rang 'od dang ldan pas na lha/ bsam gtan gyi bde ba dang ldan pas na mchog ste sum cu rtsa gsum pa thams cad kyi tshal lo/ /de ji lta bu zhe na/ gnas de na shar du shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal/ lho na rtsub 'gyur gyi tshal/ nub na 'dres pa'i tshal/ byang na dga' ba'i tshal dang bzhi yod pa las phyi ma'o/ /de nyid lha rnams kyi bsod nams las grub pa'am/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes nyid der snang bas na yid du 'ong ba'o/ /na zhes pa ni tshig phrad do/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ me tog la sogs pa'i khyad par/ rgyan gyi khyad par/ sgra'i khyad par/ rtse ba'i khyad par/ byin rlabs kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po ni/ nor bu dang zhes sogs te/ me tog 'di dag ni mi yul na med cing sum cu rtsa gsum na yod pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dpag bsam gyi shing rnams kyis mdzes par byas shing gzhal yas khang gi rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'o/

/gsum pa ni/ dkon mchog brtsegs pa nas bshad pa lta bu'i bya mang po sna tshogs zhes sogs te/ ka re ko ni 'khar rnga'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ brgya byin dang zhes sogs te/ brgya byin mig brgya dang ldan pa'am/ yab rgyal po gha na pa tis longs spyod kyi rgyan du nor bu ti la ka khal brgya dus gcig la sbyin pa btang bas na brgya byin no/ /tshangs pa ni tshad med bzhi'i rnam smin gyis 'bras bu'i gzugs khams su skyes pas na'o/ /lnga pa ni/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs pa na zhes pa'o/ /drug pa la gnyis te/ 'khor gyi che ba dang ston pa'i che bas bzhugs pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ 'jig rten dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'o/ /dang po ni/ brgya byin dang / zhes sogs te/ brgya byin ni sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gtso bo/ tshangs pa ni gzugs khams pa'i gtso bo/ rig 'dzin ni rten mi'i lus la bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin skyes pa 'jig rten pa'i rig 'dzin dang / rten lha'i lus la bsam gtan gyi ting nge 'dzin skyes pas tshe bskal par thub/ sprul sku'i zhing khams su 'gro nus/ ci bsams pa nam mkha' las 'byung zhing nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa ni 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rig 'dzin no/ /lha'i bu bu mo 'khor bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong du ma ni bye ba ni bgrangs pa'i grangs kyi gnas gzhan brgyad pa'o/ /gnod sbyin ni gang ba bzang po la sogs pa'o/ /srin po ni lang ka mgrin bcu'o/ /lha ma yin ni thags zangs ris la sogs pa'o/ /dri za ni zur phud lnga pa la sogs pa'o/ /mi'am ci ni ljon pa rta mgo can la sogs pa'o/ /lto 'phye chen po ni sbrul mgo bdun pa'o/ /klu ni dga' bo la sogs pa ste/ sogs kyi sgras bsdus pa ni grul bum gsus po che la sogs pa'o/ /de ltar 'jig rten pa'i tshul 'dzin pa'i 'khor du ma dang bcas pa ni bgrang du mi lang ba'o/

/gnyis pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' zhes sogs te/ dngos su smos pa'i byang sems dgu po/ rtsa skya pas phyag na rdo rje/ 'jam dpal/ nam mkha'i snying po/ 'jig rten dbang phyug nam mkha' mdzod/ 'khor los sgyur ba/ rdo rje khu tshur/ rdo rje gnod sbyin/ rdo rje las rnams la sbyor bar mdzad cing / rje btsun gyis 'di rnams la 'di yin bya ba med pas de dag la sbyor ba mi 'thad gsung / kha cig phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yin par yang 'dod/ phyir mi ldog pa ni sa dang po'i byang sems sngags thob pa'i byin rlabs kyis phyir mi ldog sa brgyad pa'i byang sems sgrib pa med pa'i gnas thob pas phyir mi ldog ste/ de lta bu'i dge 'dun grangs kyi mthar thug pa med pa rnams kyis bsti stang ste bsnyen bkur du byed/ ston pa shākya thub pa la bla mar byed/ me tog la sogs pas mchod cing brjod/ rang la yang zhen pa med pas rab tu mchod cing sangs rgyas kyi yon tan spel te/ de lta bu'i 'khor mang po'i dbus na bzhugs zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ston pa'i che bas bzhugs pa ni/ su zhig bzhugs na/ tshad med pa bzhi dang ldan pas na tshangs pa/ chos dbyings rtogs pa'i don gyis chen po ste/ sangs rgyas shākya thub pa nyid 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pa mtshon pas padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir tshangs pa chen po sangs rgyas kyi ming gi rnam grangs yin pa'i don ma rtogs par/ tshangs pa chen po yin na zhal bzhi yod dgos zhes smra ba ni rgyud 'gog pa ste/ ston pa shākya thub pa padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa la tshangs pa chen po padma'i gdan la bzhugs par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gleng bslang ba la gnyis te/ ston pas gleng bslang ba dang / 'khor gyis gleng bslang ba'o/ /dang po la drug ste/ rgyu ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa dang / thabs 'od zer gyi spro bsdu dang / 'bras bu ngan song las grol bar bstan pa dang /

mchod pa sngon du song bas ched du brjod pa dang / brgya byin la sogs pas ngo mtshar bar bstan pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ngoṃ mtshar bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas ston pas ngan song gi rgyud de rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i sdug bsngal dang 'brel ba'i shes pa sbreng chags thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar snyoms par zhugs nas ting nge 'dzin gyi ming ngan song gsum gyi rgyud las rnam par grol ba zhes sogs te/ gzhan rnams ni go sla la/ byang chub sems dpa' dang / sems dpa' chen po ni snying rje chen po dang / shes rab chen po'o/ /gsum pa ni/ kun du snang bar byas pas de sems can thams cad kyi sems 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pas byas pa'i 'ching ba las rnam par grol/ lus sems kyi bde ba so sor thob nas ston pa'i bzhugs gnas dga' ba'i tshal thams cad kun tu gang bar byas te'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ mchod pa'i sprin zhes sogs te/ nor bu dri ma med pa ni thugs ye shes sa gzhir snang ba ste/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ sems nyid nor bu rin po che/ /ji ltar dmigs shing bsam par snang / /'gro ba'i sems rgyud gnyis mi 'chad/ /de ni ye shes kun gyi gzhi/ /zhes so/ /e ma ho ngo mtshar ba/ sangs rgyas gsum ni chos sku/ longs sku/ sprul sku gsum yin la/ de dag gi mdzad pa legs pa ni/ gang gi phyir na rgyud dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i ngan song las bdag cag rnams smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu'i 'od zer gyis sbyangs nas chos nyan pa'i skal ba can du byas pas byang chub spyod pa nyid la bkod pa'i phyir ro/ /'di dag gis sngon byung la bcom ldan 'das kyi smin mtshams kyi mdzod spu'i 'od zer gyi spro bsdus ngan song sbyangs nas de dag gi ched brjod byas par bstan la/ rjes 'jug la bdag bskyed kyi gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis ting nge 'dzin la 'jug dgos par ston no/

/lnga pa ni/ de nas lha'i dbang po zhes sogs te go sla'o/ /drug pa ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po zhes bos nas 'di ni ngo mtshar cheṃ ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni rgyu'i dus na/ tshad med grangs med pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs phar phyin drug gis bsdus pa yang dag par bsags pa'o/ /'bras bu'i dus na re 'dod thams cad skong bar byed pas yon tan rin po che'i 'byung khungs su gyur pa'o/ /rgyu'i dus su shes rab chen po'i sgo nas tshad med pa'i thabs yang dag par rdzogs pa'o/ /thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab tshad med pa bsags pa'o/ /sku gsung thugs kyi spyod pa ni tshad med pa'o/ /'bras bu'i dus su gdul bya'i skye bo tshad med pa rnams gsang sngags spyod pa'i snod du gyur par mdzad pa'o/ /mi mnyam pa ni/ so so skye bo/ phyi rol pa/ nyan rang / byang sems rnams dang mi mnyam pa yin la/ mnyam pa ni dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kun dang chos dbyings mnyam par rtogs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i ye shes ni rdo rje rtse mo las/ ye nas shes pas ye shes te/ /slar yang chos su rtogs pa min/ /rtag dang chad pa spong byed pa/ /'chi med de la ye shes brjod/ /ces pa ltar ro/ /rdzu 'phrul ni lus kyi mthu'o/ /smon lam gyi stobs ni 'bad rtsol la mi ltos pas smon lam mo/ /rgyu mtshan dgu po de lta bas na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams ni sku'i sgo nas snod ji lta ba bzhin du/ gsung gi sgo nas ji ltar 'dul ba bzhin du dang / thugs kyi sgo nas mos pa ji lta ba bzhin du sems can gyi don mdzad pa yin par shes par byas te 'di la zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa 'khor gyis gleng bslang ba la brgyad de/ brgya byin gyis ston pa la spobs pa bskyed cig par gsol ba gdab pa dang / nor bu dri ma med pa gang du skyes par lung bstan par gsol zhes zhus pa dang /

bcom ldan 'das kyis dus la bab na nyon cig par gdams pa bstan pas brgya byin gyis dus la bab par khas blangs pa dang / dri ma med pa'i skye rgyud bstan pa dang / brgya byin la sogs pa skyo ba skyes te 'gyel ba dang / bcom ldan 'das la nor bu dri ma med pa sdug bsngal las thar pa'i thabs zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis nyon cig par bstan pa dang / zhus pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin rang gi stan las langs te zhes sogs te/ spyir rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang 'phrad par 'dod pa'i phan pa nyid du bgyi ba dang / dud 'gro la sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i snying brtse ba nyid du bgyi ba dang / yi dwags la snying rje can nyid du bgyi ba dang / dmyal ba la snying brtse ba can chen po nyid du bgyi ba dang / thun mong du 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub bde ba dang yid bde bas bsdus pa'i bsam pa thams cad zhes sogs te/ bdag spobs pa bskyed pa ni blo chen po dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs shig pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i ris 'di nyid nas zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po ci ste zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od zhes sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ de nas brgya byin la sogs pa lha'i bu thams cad kyis thos nas zhes sogs so/ /drug pa ni/ de nas yang langs nas zhes sogs so/ /bdun pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po sangs rgyas zhes sogs so/ /brgyad pa la gnyis te/ brgya byin gyis zhus pa dang / tshangs pa la sogs pas zhus pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis yang bcom ldan 'das la zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs zhes sogs so/

/gsum pa rgyud kyi gzhung dngos la gnyis te/ ston pas 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa dang / rgyud dngos so/ /dang po ni/ gsol ba btab pa'i rjes de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis brgya byin dang tshangs pa la sogs pa 'khor du 'dus pa'i lha'i bu de dag de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs bskul ba'i don gyis snying po 'dis 'khor rnams snod rung du byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir/ 'bras bu'i skal ba can du byed pas na don yod pa/ stong nyid rdo rjes byin gyis brlab pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so/ /de nas yang sngags 'di phyung nas lha de dag sngags kyi dam tshig can du byin gyis brlabs so/ /oṃ ni bkra shis pa ste/ rtse mo las/ yi ge oṃ ni ci yin brjod/ /mchog dang nor gter dpal dang g.yang / /skal bzang rnam pa dang ldan zhing / /dam bca' ba dang bkra shis don/ /nor bu 'dzin pa'i snying po yin/ /zhes sogs so/ /a dhi ni bdag po'o/ /tiṣṭha ni byin rlabs/ dzña na ye shes/ sa ma ya ni dam tshig hūm̐ ni ye shes lnga 'dus pa'o/ /de ltar ting 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas kyang / gdon mi za ba ste nges par tshad med pa'i don gyis na mi choms pas rdo rjes byin gyis rlabs kyis brgya byin la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs zhes pa'o/ /'di dag gi don ni/ sngon byung la ston pas 'khor rnams ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du bcug ste/ rgyud nyan pa'i skal ba can du mdzad pa yin la/ rjes 'jug gi gdul byas rgyud nyan pa la dbang bskur sngon du 'gro dgos par bstan cing cho ga nyams su len pa na/ tshe ldan dang tshe 'das la sngags 'dis byin gyis brlab dgos par bstan no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ shākya thub pas gsungs pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang / phyag na rdo rje'i zhal nas gsungs pa'i brtag pa phyi ma'o/ /dang po la drug ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba phan yon dang bcas pa bstan pa dang /

nang gi dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro bas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba dang / ras bris la brten pa'i dngos grub dang / ngan song gi sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs kyi bye brag rnams bstan pa dang / nor bu dri ma med pa ngan song las thon pa phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa dang / rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis/ sngags kyi phreng ba dngos dang / phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyal po zhes sogs te/ sngon byung las/ sngags 'di dag ston pa'i thugs kha nas phyung ba phan yon dang bcas pa bstan la/ rjes 'jug la/ sngon du bsnyen pa'i cho ga nyams su len pa bstan te/ de la yang dpa' bo gcig pa'i bsnyen pa dang / dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen pa gnyis las/ phyi ma bstan no/ /ji ltar na/ oṃ sha zhes pas snod bcud stong nyid du sbyang pa bstan la/ oṃ bha zhes pas 'byung ba rim rtsegs bsgom pa bstan cing / shugs las gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bsgom pa yang bstan no/ /de nas rigs lnga'i sngags dang pos ni zlos sngags dang / rigs lnga'i sngags gnyis pas ni bskyed sngags dang / rigs lnga'i sngags gsum pas ni bum pa la bzlos sngags bstan/ rtsa rig ni thun mong gi bzlos sngags dang / sngags dngos su ma bstan pa rnams kyi bskyed sngags bstan no/ /yang ro chas su gzhug pa'i tshe/ gnas rnams la gdags pa'i yi ge yang bstan no/ /de la rigs lnga so so dang / gnas so so la sbyor tshul bstan pa ni rigs lnga'i sngags tshan dang pos ni rim pa ltar rnam snang dang mdzod spu/ rgya mchog rin chen dang rna ba g.yas/ shākya rig dbang dang rna ba g.yon/ me tog cher rgyas dang gtsug phud/ sbyong rgyal dang dpung pa g.yas rnams so/ /de nas rtsa rigs ni lha thams cad kyi thun mong dang snying kha'o/ /rigs lnga'i sngags tshan gnyis pa ni rim pa bzhin kun rig dang sna gong / sbyong rgyal dang rked pa/

rgyal mchog rin chen dang pus mo g.yas/ shākya rig dbang dang pus mo g.yon/ me tog cher rgyas dang bol gong g.yas rnams bstan no/ /rigs lnga'i sngags tshan gsum pas ni rim pa bzhin/ kun rig dang bol gong g.yon/ shākya rig dbang dang long bu g.yas/ rin chen me tog dang long bu g.yon/ sbyong rgyal dang sna'i rtse mo/ me tog cher rgyas dang mig g.yas rnams bstan no/ /oṃ sha ni mig g.yon/ oṃ bha ni gsang gnas so/ /sngags don gzhan rnams ni go sla la/ sho dha ni gnyis ni sbyong ba gnyis/ sarba pā paṃ ni sdig pa thams cad/ bi sho dha ni/ rnam par sbyong ba/ shuddhe dag pa/ bi shuddhe rnam par dag pa/ sarba karmā ā wa ra ṇa ni las kyi sgrib pa thams cad/ bi shuddhe rnam par dag pa/ swā hā ni gzhi tshugs pa'o/ /sarba a bha ya ni sgrib pa thams cad/ sarba sa twa sems can thams cad/ bi sho dha ni ha na ni rnam par dag cing bsnun pa'o/ /hūm̐ dang / phaṭa dang / swā hā gsum ni rdo rje rtse mo las/ yi ge hūm̐ ni ci yin brjod/ /sdug bsngal 'chos shing 'joms par byed/ /srid pa'i zhags pa gcod byed cing / /gdug pa sdang zhing gsod byed pa/ /hūm̐ ni mchog tu dran par bya/ /zhes dang / yi ge phaṭa ni ci yin brjod/ /gdug dang sdug bsngal 'joms byed cing / /bde ba dag ni 'gugs par byed/ /phaṭa ni 'joms byed sgra yin te/ /grogs dang bcas te 'joms par byed/ /ces dang / swā hā ces pa ci yin brjod/ /sdig pa thams cad zhi byed cing / /dge ba'i tshogs ni 'phel bar byed/ /nyes par bcas pa 'phrog byed cing / /du ཿkha thams cad 'joms par byed/ /ces so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ sngags thos pa la sogs pa'i phan yon/ sngags de dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ lha'i dbang po de bzhin gshegs pa ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i gsang ba'i snying po 'di zhes sogs te/

gzhan rnams ni go sla la/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba brgyad ni/ mtshon/ dug rgyal po'i chad pa/ 'brum nad/ gcan gzan/ chom rkun/ mer tshig pa/ chur shi ba dang brgyad do/ /de dang 'brel ba'i rmi lam gyi rnam pa ni thur la bab pa gos dang bral ba gcan gzan gyis zos pa/ nyi zla nub pa/ nam sros pa la sogs pa yin par rtsa skya pas bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor du ji lta ba bzhin du zhugs la zhes sogs te/ ngan song du 'gro bar yang mi 'gyur ro zhes pa yan chad kyis tshe ldan la dbang bskur ba'i phan yon dang / myong bar 'gyur ro zhes pa yan chad kyis tshe 'das la dbang bskur ba'i phan yon bstan te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis chos nyid mngon sum du byed pa ni sa dang po yan chad/ bsnyen bskur ni rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis lus kyi bsnyen bkur ba/ phyir mi ldog pa ni 'khor ba dang / theg dman lam du phyir mi ldog pa/ rgyud nges pa can ni theg pa chen por ro/ /rigs su skyes pa ni byang chub sems dpar ro/ /sgrib pa thams cad rab tu spangs pa ni ser sna la sogs pa'i nyon sgrib dang / gzung 'dzin gyi rtog pa shes bya'i sgrib pa dang / mtshams med lnga po las kyi sgrib pa dang / sgrib pa lnga po chos kyi sgrib pa ste bzhi yod par kun dga' snying pos de nyid snang bar bshad do/ /gnyis pa nang gi dkyil 'khor sngon du 'gro bas rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba la gsum ste/ brgya byin gyis bshad par gsol ba gdab pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bshad pa'i don du ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa/ bshad pa dngos so/ /dang po ni/ de nas lha rnams kyi dbang po zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das zhes sogs te/ ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i chos dbyings shes pas ye shes rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas don byed pa po/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ bya ba ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i snying po'am nang gi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di gsungs so/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ nang gi dkyil 'khor dang / phyi'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /dang po ni/ sa bcu gcig pa'i sas bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub kyi sems la don dam dang / kun rdzob gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba dmigs pa med pa yin te/ dbu ma las/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub sems/ /bdag dang phung po rnam rig gi /rtog pa rnams kyis ma bsgribs shing / /rtag tu stong nyid mtshan nyid bzhed/ /ces so/ /de nyid gong na med cing phul du byung bas na bla na med pa'o/ /kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems ni don dam byang chub kyi sems de rtogs par 'gyur ba'am rtogs pa'i thabs su gyur pa ste/ smon pa dang 'jug pa gnyis so/ /dang po ni/ sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas 'dod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lam la 'jug pa ste/ bsnyen pa nas brtsams te/ rgyud 'di nas 'byung ba'i rang don dang gzhan don gyi las la 'jug pa'o/ /de ltar gnyis las/ 'das pa'i rgyal ba bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis gsungs pa'i don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi ye shes gang yin pa de ni rtogs bya mthar thug dang / bcud dam dwangs mar gyur pas na dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs so/ /de rtogs pa'i thabs su gyur pa 'das pa'i rgyal ba bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis gsungs pa'i kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ye shes gang yin pa de ni 'byung gnas su 'gyur ba'am gces par 'gyur ba'i don gyis na dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs so/ /'dir kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems la gnyis las/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems ni lam nyams su len pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor yin pas 'dir mngon rtogs kyi tho bsgrigs te bshad pa ni/

dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis po thams cad la/ sngon du bsnyen pa/ dkyil 'khor las rim/ dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par khrus byas te/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas lha'i rnal 'byor la 'jug pa ni/ kun rig nas/ de nas khrus la sogs byas te/ /dri dang phreng mchog phreng ba can/ /zhes so/ /de nas skyabs 'gro ni/ thub pa'i skabs nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /thos nas kyang ni skyabs su song / /zhes dang / tshe dpag med nas/ dkon mchog gsum dang byang chub sems/ /bla ma dam pa rnams mi spang / /zhes sogs so/ /chos bdag med pa dran cing sems bskyed pa ni/ 'khor los sgyur ba nas/ stong pa mtshan ma med pa'i sems/ /zhes dang / kun rig nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems/ /zhes so/ /srung 'khor bsgom pa la/ thog mar phyag rdor bskyed pa ni/ me ltar 'bar ba nas/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes zhes gsungs la/ de nyid 'jig rten gsum rgyal du bsgyur ba ni/ rang gi sku bor te rdo rje sems dpa'i skur zhugs nas zhes dang / kun rig nas/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam rgyal gyis/ /bdag bsrung la sogs byas nas ni/ /zhes so/ /de nyid kyi sku'i rnam pa ni/ me ltar 'bar ba nas/ ma rungs snying khar mnan nas bsdigs byed cing / /zhal ni shin tu 'jigs 'jigs blta/ /phyag ni brgya phrag du mar ldan/ /sbrul dang mi sdug mgos brgyan pa/ /stag lpags kyis ni smad g.yogs bgos/ /rgyu ma thogs shing dbu mtha' yas/ /mgo thod shas bkang phyag na bsnams/ /zhes so/ /bdag bsrung sogs kyi sngags ni/ de nyid las/ rdo rje sems dpa'i khro bo me nyi ma bya ba'i snying po 'di nyid kyi thugs kha nas phyung ngo / /oṃ badzra sa twa kro dha zhes sogs gsungs so/ /de dag ni rgyud kyi dngos bstan gyi srung 'khor bsdus pa yin la/ rgyas pa ni/ sngar gyi tshig rkang gnyis po de la brten nas bla ma'i man ngag gi rdo rje 'byung ba bzhin mdzad do/

/srung 'khor gyi rjes la lag pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'khor los sgyur ba nas/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la zhes pa nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yin par mos pa bskyed de zhes pa'i bar gsungs la/ de nas chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa dang / bdag dang yang rjes su dran par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i don gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba bya ba ni/ rdo rje 'byung ba las/ gzugs brnyan la sogs pa'i sbyor bas phyag rgya bcing ba sngon du 'gro ba dang / cho ga thams cad rjes su bskyed par bya ste/ zhes dang / de yi sngags dang phyag rgya yang / thal mo dam du bsdams pa las/ /sor mo thams cad bsnol ba ni/ /rdo rje thal mor bka' stsal te/ /rab tu bsdams phyir rdo rje bsdams/ /badzra añtsa li zhes bya ba ni rdo rje thal mo'i sngags so/ /badzra bandha zhes bya ba ni rdo rje bsdams pa ste/ badzra bandha tra tha zhes bya ba lan gsum brjod cing snying khar bkrol lo zhes pa nas ye shes dbab pa'i bar gsungs so/ /bdag bskyed dngos la/ dpa' bo gcig pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs rdzogs bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ kun rig nas/ bdag gis de nyid dran byed cing / /zhes pas ston la/ ji ltar sgom pa'i tshul ni tshe dpag med nas/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med par/ /zhes pa nas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan la/ zla ba'i 'og tu padma bsgom pa ni gleng gzhi nas padma'i gdan la bzhugs te zhes pa'i bstan/ rang gi sa bon dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa ni shākya thub pa nas gsungs la/ ltag 'og go rim ji bzhin du sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i sngags ni phyag rdor nas gsungs so/ /rje btsun gyis sbyong rgyud kyi dngos bstan bzhin mdzad pas 'di la ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug mi mdzad la/ rtsa skya ba ni ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug kyang mdzad do/

/sgrib pa sbyong ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni gleng gzhi nas tshangs pa chen po zhes sogs gsungs/ mchod bstod ni me ltar 'bar ba nas/ rin chen gdugs la sogs mchog gis/ /mchod pa sna tshogs byas nas kyang / /phyag na rdo rje rgyas spyan la/ /dga' ba'i bsam pas bstod byed pa/ /sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /bzlas sngags ni gong du gsungs pa'i rtsa rig yin la/ de'i dmigs pa ni phyag rdor nas 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad snang bar byas te/ snang bar byas nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul du byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi chos kyi yi ge de nyid du zhugs par gyur to zhes so/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi bsnyen pa ni/ sngags kyi phreng ba'i skabs su bstan pa sngar bshad zin cing / de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs zhes pa'i de ma thag tu phyi'i dkyil 'khor gsungs pa zhes pa'i shugs kyis kyang nang gi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa bstan la/ dkyil 'khor snga ma bzhin bsams la zhes pas kyang bstan no/ /sgom tshul sngar dpa' bo gcig pa'i skabs su rdo rje sems dpa' 'am rang rang gi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gang bsgoms kyang rung ste/ 'gro ba ngan song las grol ba'i ched du brjod pa'i bar byas pa'i rjes la rtsa skya pa ltar na sngar gyi phyag rgya chen po nam mkhar bteg ste/ snod bcud stong par sbyangs nas 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed de/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du phyag rgya chen po phab nas de'i thugs kha nas 'khor spro bar bzhed la/ rje btsun gyis ni phyag rgya chen po nam mkhar mi 'degs par stong par sbyangs nas gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed pa'i bar byas la/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du mtha' skor du rtsa rig dang / nang skor du rtsa ba'i sngags bkod pa las 'od zer gyi spro bsdu byas nas gtso bo bskyed/

de'i thugs khar zla ba'i steng du mtha' skor du rtsa rig dang / nang skor du 'khor gang yin gyi sngags bkod pa las 'od zer spro bsdu byas nas 'khor de dang de bskyed de rang gnas su spro bar mdzad do/ /de nas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa nas phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs pa'i bar mdun bskyed bzhin byas nas mchod bstod snga ma bzhin byas nas gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags bzlas te mjug tu ye shes pa gshegs su gsol lo/ /ras bris la brten pa'i bsnyen pa ni 'og gzhung don gyi skabs su 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor las rim la sa chog ni/ kun rig nas/ gtsug lag khang ngam skyed mos tshal/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan/ lha sta gon ni rgyud 'dir dngos su ma gsungs pas ma byas kyang rung la/ 'og tu slob ma sta gon gsungs pa'i shugs kyis byed par spro na 'gal ba med do/ /dkyil 'khor bri ba ni/ kun rig nas/ gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /zhes pa nas/ rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bar gsungs shing / dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams kyi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par ni so so'i skabs su 'byung ngo / /lha dgod tshul ni/ kun rig nas/ dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni/ /zhes pa nas/ thig le rnams kyang bri bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i bar gsungs shing / gzhan rnams kyi khyad par yang so so'i skabs su gsal bar 'byung ngo / /mchod gtor dang bum pa bsham tshul ni/ kun rig nas/ de nas mkhas pas dkyil 'khor la/ /zhes pa nas/ rab tu bkang ba bzhag par bya/ /zhes gsung shing / so so'i skabs su cung zad 'byung ngo / /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la/ bdag bskyed skabs 'dir dngos su ma gsungs kyang / ras bris kyi skabs su/ bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing / /zhes gsungs pas bstan/ bum bzlas ni/ kun rig nas/ snga ma bzhin du bum pa la/ /brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni/ /zhes gsungs shing dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la yang /

phyogs skyong rang gi sngags btab pa'i/ /bum pa rnams kyis dbang bskur te/ /zhes sogs gsungs so/ /mdun bskyed bsgrub pa la/ thog mar lus kyi spyod lam dang / dkyil 'khor khang par 'jug tshul ni/ kun rig nas/ de nas khrus la sogs byas la/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang lnga gsungs de nas rgyud 'dir mdun bskyed la dam tshig pa bskyed pa dngos su ma gsungs pas ye shes pa spyan drang ba ni/ kun rig nas/ gtso bo rgyal ba sras kyi 'khor/ /mang po rnams ni spyan drangs te/ /zhes gsungs la/ dkyil 'khor gzhan rnams la yang 'di kho na bzhin bya'o/ /dam tshig pa bskyed par spro na rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gzhan bzhin du bya bar man ngag las 'byung ste/ gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed nas 'od zer gyi spro bsdu las bskyed pa'am/ snying po tshig tsam las bskyed pa gang 'grub bya'o/ /dgug gzhug gi rjes su phyag rgya bzhis rgyas 'debs pa ni dam tshig gi phyag rgya ni dngos su bshad la/ las kyi phyag rgya ni 'khor los sgyur ba'i skabs nas dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i rjes la de nyid gnyis su byas nas/ gar byas na las kyi 'o zhes dang / chos kyi phyag rgya yang de nyid las/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi sa bon lta bu bshad cing / phyag rgya chen po ni shugs las grub pa nyid do/ /mchod pa/ bstod pa/ gtor ma rnams ni kun rig nas/ arghaṃ mchog btags gsang la sogs pa yi/ /zhes pa nas/ de yi gtor ma ji ltar mthun par bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gsungs so/ /slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug shing dbang blang ba ni kun rig nas/ dngos su ma gsungs kyang phyogs skyong gi skabs nas/ de nas bdag nyid zhugs nas kyang / /zhes 'jug pa dang / tshe dpag med nas/ de nas bdag nyid dbang bskur te/ /zhes dbang blang bar gsungs shing / 'khor los sgyur ba nas/ spyan drangs bdag nyid 'jug par bya/ /bdag nyid kyi ni dbang yang bskur/ /zhes 'jug pa dang dbang blang ba gnyis kyang gsungs so/

/mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ni tshe dpag med nas/ skyil krung bcas te 'dug la zhes pa nas/ de'i tshe yid kyi las thams cad nus par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i bar gsungs/ bdag mdun tha mi dad du bsgrub pa ni tshe dpag med nas/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la/ oṃ badzra dha ra zhes pa nas/ nga rgyal bskyed la zhes pa'i bar gsungs so/ /slob ma dbang bskur la 'jug pa'i chos bcu bdun ni/ kun rig nas/ de nas sngags pas bla med byang chub kyi/ /zhes pa nas/ bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis go rim bstan la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par rnams ni so so'i skabs nas 'byung ngo / /dbang gi dngos gzhi la sngags dbang dang / bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang bcu dang / thabs shes rab kyi dbang dang / rin chen sna bdun gyi dbang ste bcu dgu ni/ mos pa brtan dang ldan pas dam bcas nas/ /zhes pa nas/ sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan la/ sngags rnams ni phyag rdor nas 'byung ngo / /bka' bsgo ba dang bla ma la yon 'bul ba ni/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang / /zhes sogs dang / des kyang mos pas spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ /zhes sogs kyis bstan no/ /mjug chog ni me ltar 'bar ba nas/ /de yi lus la dbang bskur zhing / /mnyam par gzhag pas bsrungs nas kyang / /mjug du mngon par mchod nas ni/ /lha rnams thams cad gshegs par gsol/ /zhes pa 'di dngos su sbyin sreg gi mjug chog tu gsungs kyang / mdun bskyed kyi mjug chog thams cad 'dis bstan pa yin no/ /gsum pa dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab pa ni gzhung so so'i steng du rtogs par bya'o/ /de ltar na rgyud 'dir kha 'phangs pa yod kyang cho ga dngos su ma bshad pa rnams de nyid 'dus pa sogs nas kha bskang ba ma gtogs rgyud 'dir dngos su gsungs pa'i cho ga gong 'og 'khrugs bsdebs nas/

rgyud kyi dngos bstan bzhin du mdzad pa 'di ni paṇḍi ta dharmā pha la'i man ngag jo bo rin chen bzang po nas sa skya pa la brgyud pa dang / jo bo rje nas rtsa snur 'dzim gsum la brgyud pa rnams phal cher 'dra zhing / khyad par du 'phags pa 'ga' zhig yod pa 'di'i rjes su 'brang ba ni skal ba bzang bar shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa phyi'i dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ sdud pa po'i mtshams sbyor dang / gzhung ngo / /dang po ni/ de nas yang bcom ldan 'das kyis zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /dang po la drug ste/ dkyil 'khor bri ba'i gnas/ sa'i cho ga thig btab ste bri ba/ lha dgod pa/ mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa/ zhugs te sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇḍi ta'i gtsug lag khang dang / rgyal po'i skye shing gi rwa ba skyed mos tshal dang / phyi byang chub chen po'i mchod rten dang / nang gsung rab bzhugs pa'i lha khang dang / dge 'dun mang po 'du ba'i kun dga' rwa ba dang / sogs kyi sgras bsdus pa grong dang grong khyer la sogs pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa chog bya dgos pa rnams kyi phyogs su rgyas par byed na/ rdo rje rtse mo'am/ gsang ba spyi rgyud dam/ de dag gi don bsdus pa kun dga' snying pos mdzad par grags pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga rnams nas gsungs pa'i ji bzhin pa yi cho ga yis gnas ni byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga tsam mo/ /de tsam bya ba ma grub na sa phyogs der gtor ma rgyas par btang la/ sa phyogs de na gnas pa'i mi ma yin pa la zhi bas bslang / khro bo'i sngags zlos shing / gu gul gyi dud pa dang / yungs kar gyis brab cing drag pos blang ngo / /lag pas mnan la/ sa gzhi nam mkhar bsgoms nas oṃ bhū khaṃ zhes pa dang / oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes mang du bzlas te/ dkyil 'khor ci tsam byed pa'i sa gzhi mdzes par ga dar legs par bya'o/

/sa chog bsdus pa 'di ni bla ma'i gsung ngo / /gsum pa la gnyis te/ spyi'i don dang / gzhung gi don no/ /dang po ni/ spyi chings las/ spyir dkyil 'khor chen po thams cad la cha chen bcu drug btab la/ de nas rtsig pa dang / 'dod yon dang / pha gu dang / drwa phyed dang / mda' yab dang / de'i shugs la 'byung ba sgo 'gram dang / ya phubs dang / sgo khyud dang / sgo logs dang / ka ba dang / rta bab sgo'i sum 'gyur ram/ bzhi 'gyur gang mdzes dang / rta bab ni glang po che'i rgyab bam/ mchod rten gyi dbyibs gang mdzes dang / 'khor lo dang / ri dwags dang bcas pa rnams la sgo ni cha chen gyi tshad yin la/ 'dod yon dang / drwa phyed dang / 'khor lo rnams ni cha chung gi tshad yin zhing / gzhan rnams ni cha phran gyi tshad yin par shes par bya ba ni thams cad kyi phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par bzhag pa yin no/ /nang gi dkyil 'khor ni lha snam yod pa'am/ med par shes par byas la/ de'i nang du 'khor lo'i rtsibs lte ba mu khyud dang bcas par shes par bya'o/ /kun rig la/ khyad par du sgo rkyang dang sgo sbrag gnyis kyi dbye ba shes par bya ste/ de'ang sgo rkyang la sbyar na/ srad bu brgyad dang ldan pa dang / /zhes bya ba la sogs pa la/ srad bu brgyad ni tshangs thig gi ngos re re nas cha chen brgyad brgyad do/ /de bas na cha bcu drug tu 'gyur te/ 'di ni sgo rkyang sgo sbrags gnyis ka'i thun mong ngo / /phyi yi sgo khyud rnams kyis brgyan/ /zhes bya ba ni/ sgo khyud dang rta babs la sogs pa rgyan rnams bya'o/ /zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i don to/ /dgu yi char ni bgos pa las/ /zhes pa ni/ 'khor lo'i lte ba la thig gnyis btab pa las le tshe dgur byas pa yin no/ /sgo dang sgo khyud sum char bya/ /zhes bya ba ni dgu cha'i phyogs gcig na 'phar ma le tshe gsum yod la/ de'i sum cha gtso bo'i gnas lta bu gcig dang / sgo dang sgo khyud mnyam pa yin no/

/de'ang ji ltar gdab zhe na sgo rkyang gi paṇa reg gi rtsig pa phan tshun thad kar gdung gi tshul du btab la/ de nas lha snam cha chen gcig bor la zlum por bskor/ de nas paṇa reg gi tshad gcig mu khyud du bskor/ de nas cha phran sum cha bor la cha chen gnyis pa'i thig lnga bskor te lte ba bya/ cha phran gsum bor ba de la 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug phyogs re rer bzhi bzhi bya/ de nas nang gi cha phran gcig lte ba'i mu khyud la bskor bar bya'o/ /yang lte ba ni de nyid yin la 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i mu khyud la cha chen gnyis btang la/ lha snam gyi lha tshogs rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du 'god pa yin te/ de ltar na 'og nas 'byung ba'i rim pa gsum dang ldan pa'i rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ zhes bya ba'i gzhung yang gtso bo dang sbyong ba'i rgyal po dang / 'khor lo'i rtsibs te rim pa gsum yin la nang gi lha'i sa gnyis la cha chen gnyis 'khor lo'i rtsibs la cha chen gnyis yin pas na rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur zhes bya'o/ /sgo sbrag gi dbang du byas nas/ phyi yi sgo khyud rnams kyi rgyan/ /zhes 'byung bas na gong du bstan pa rnams nang ni dkyil 'khor yin par mngon no/ /de ltar phyi'i cha chung ni nang gi cha chen du bya/ phyi'i cha phran ni nang gi cha chung du bya'o/ /phyi'i cha phran phyed ni nang gi cha phran du byas la/ nang na cha chen brgyad yod pa de phyed phyed du bgos te cha chen bcu drug du btang la/ rta babs dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa phyi'i dkyil 'khor bzhin btab la/ nang gi sgo rkyang gi thig paṇa reg gi thig rgya gram du btab pas le tshe dgu'i gdung gi thig byas la/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor bzhin lha snam khong rang gi cha chen gcig bor ba'am ma bor kyang rung ste/ snga ma bzhin lte ba 'khor lo'i thig bskor bar bya'o/ /rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya/ /zhes bya ba ni phyi rol tu lha snam bor na 'khor lo'i rtsibs nyis 'gyur gyis chung ba yin la/

ma bor na nyis 'gyur gyis che ba yin no/ /gzhung lhag ma thams cad ni sgo rkyang sbrag thams cad 'dra ba nyid yin no zhes gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gzhung don la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ byin gyis brlab pa ste/ sa chog byas pa'i gnas der ni phyi'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya'o/ /'di la dgongs nas gnyal pa sta gon med par mdzad pa yang 'gal ba med de sa chog byas ma thag tu bri bar bshad pa'i phyir/ kha'u pa gzhung na med kyang shugs 'byung mdzad pa ltar na'ang 'gal ba med de/ slob ma la chos zab mo bshad pa dang / sdom pa 'bogs par bshad pa'i skabs de bka' dang bstan bcos phal cher nas sta gon du bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /de la byed par 'dod na/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa byi dor legs par byas pa'i steng du lha'i gnas ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir/ ci 'grub pa'i thig btab la/ lha'i gnas rnams su dri'i thig le dang / me tog tshom bu byas la mchod gtor rgyas par bshams te/ bdag gi rnal 'byor rdzogs nas mdun du 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin lha bsgrub la/ ji ltar 'byor pas mchod cing gtor ma btang nas 'chad par 'gyur ba'i slob ma 'jug pa yan chad byas nas ci bder gnas te/ nangs par spyan drangs pa'i dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol nas dkyil 'khor bri ba la 'jug par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshad med pa bzhi dag pas gru bzhi pa la rnam thar bzhi dag pas sgo bzhi pa/ bsam gtan bzhi dag pas rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa dang / sgo khang bzhi la them skas bzhi yi phreng ba dang / rta babs kyi ka ba la seng ge dang / phan glang chen po rnams kyis brgyan pa dang / khor yug tu dar sna lnga'i lda ldi dang / do shal dang / do shal phyed pa'i phreng ba dang / dril bu dang ni rnga mas brgyan no/ /sgo'i steng gi padma la shar du rdo rje/ lhor rin chen/ nub tu padma dang / byang du rgya gram pa yi phyag rgyas brgyan no/

/srad bu brgyad dang ldan pa ni/ rje btsun gyis tshangs thig gi g.yas g.yon du cha chen brgyad brgyad yod pa la gsungs shing / rtsa skya pas re mig dbus ma khyab byed du btang ba'i re mig brgyad la 'chad/ gnyan ston gyis thig chen brgyad la 'chad do/ /phyi'i sgo khyud rnams kyis brgyan pa ni sgo khyud dang rta babs la sogs pa'i rgyan rnams rdzogs par bya ba'o/ /dgu'i char ni bgos pa ni/ kha'u pa spyir 'khor lo'i lte ba la le tshe dgur bsgos nas phyogs re la gsum gsum yod pa'i sum cha gtso bo'i gnas lta bu dang / sgo dang sgo khyud mnyam pa la 'chad cing / rje btsun yang 'di nyid 'chad do/ /gnyal pa phyi rol gyi khor yug la cha chen gcig dang / cha bco brgyad du byas pa la zer la sgo dang sgo khyud sum cha zhes bya ba ni dgu char bsgyur la cha chen gcig yin no zhes zer ba 'di ni nor te/ khor yug ni thams cad la dgos kyang thig gi khongs su gtogs pa ma yin pas cha dgu pa yang ma yin la/ sum cha dgu char bsgyur ba 'di bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'goms par mi rigs so/ /rdo rje'i srad bu ni srad bu la ye shes lnga'i khams thim pa yin la de thig gdab bo/ /gru bzhi pa de'i nang du dbus kyi dkyil 'khor zlum po'i thig gdab pa ni chos kyi 'khor lo dang 'dra bar rtsibs rnams zlum por byas pa la lte bar bcas shing rtsibs kyi grangs bcu drug la mu khyud kyis bskor ba'o/ /rtsibs kyi kha dog 'dir dngos su ma gsungs kyang dam pa gong ma rnams sngon por bzhed la/ rtsa skya pas shes rab kyi bslab pa mtshon pas sngon po yin zhes gsungs kyang sems dpa' bcu drug po thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi rigs yin pa kun dga' snying pos bshad pas de mtshon byed du sngon po mdzad par mngon te/ bde mchog gi skabs su thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon por mdzad pa dang don gcig go snyam du sems so/

/rang bzo mkhan dag zhi ba'i las bsgrub pa'i skabs yin pas dkar po yin no zhes zer ba ni gzhan phan gnod 'joms su bkag zin to/ /de ltar na gtso bo dang / sbyong rgyal dang / sems dpa' bcu drug gi gnas te/ rim pa gsum du ldan pa la/ rtsibs ni nyis 'gyur nyid du bya ste lha snam cha chen gcig bzhag na nyis 'gyur gyis chung ba dang / ma bzhag na nyis 'gyur gyis che ba'i don du rje btsun gyis bzhed do/ /bzhi pa lha dgod pa ni/ le'u dgu'i dbus kyi phyogs su kun rig ni kha dog dung dang / kunda dang zla ba dang 'dra bar dkar la/ rgyu'i dus su byang chub kyi sems/ sbyin pa/ shes rab/ brtson 'grus bzhi spyod cing rdzogs pas zhal bzhi pa la 'bru 'grel ltar na/ phyag mtshan rdo rje 'dzin pa dang / rtsa skya pas rdo rje skyil krung gis seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa zhes 'chad kyang 'dir byed tshig med pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i don du mngon no/ /phyag gnyis ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgyar ldan pa/ dang ni sdud pa'i tshig yin pas mgrin pa bag tsam dgug mig sna rtser phab/ lce rkan la sbyar ba'o zhes rtsa skya pa bzhed de/ dbu rgyan la sogs pa rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan par bri'o/ /de'i spyan snga ste shar phyogs su ngan song kun sbyong ba'i rgyal po bri bar bya ste/ gdan dang zhal ma gtogs kun rig dang 'dra zhing / rgyal mchog skyes bu ni sbyong rgyal gyi ming gnyis pa yin par rje btsun bzhed cing / gang ba ni mtshan dpes spras par rtsa skya pa bzhed do/ /kun rig gi rgyab tu ste nub tu shākya'i rigs kyi dbang po gtso bo 'khor los sgyur ba'i cha byad can gyi thub pa ser po chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can bri bar bya'o/ /kun rig gi g.yas kyi phyogs lho'i char ni rgyal mchog rin chen sngon po mchog sbyin dang ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can dang /

g.yon gyi phyogs byang gi char ni me tog cher rgyas ljang gu skyabs sbyin dang ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can gnyis bri bar bya'o/ /'dir jo bo rje'i gsung gis sku mdog dmigs bsal med pa rnams dkar po yin no zhes gsung zhing / rje btsun gyis kyang kun rig dang sbyong rgyal gnyis dkar po ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can du dngos su gsungs pa'i shugs kyis rigs gzhan gsum po yang de ltar du grub pa rgyud kyi dgongs par bzhed do/ /lo tsa na dang / mā ma kī dang / de bzhin du gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma rnams ni rang gi rigs kyi mtshan ma spyan/ rdo rje/ padma/ utpal bzhi ste/ de'i rnam par shar lho la sogs pa'i grwa yi phyogs su ni kun tu bri'o/ /'di ni yum bzhi po mtshan ma'i gzugs su sbas par de nyid 'dus pa'i rgyud las gsungs shing / lo chen dang / smṛ tis bzhengs pa'i gtsug lag khang rnams na yang de ltar du yod pa dang don gcig par mngon no/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi nang ni thams cad du rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i sems dpa' thugs kyi rigs yin pas na mchog sku mdog dang phyag mtshan sna tshogs su sprul pas na rdzu 'phrul che ba'i sems dpa' rnams byang shar gyi phyogs nas brtsams ste g.yas skor du go rim bzhin du bri bar bya'o/ /bri ba la mkhas pas lā sye la sogs pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad rtsibs kyi phyi rol gyi grwa'i phyogs su bri'o/ /nang gi sgo yi phyogs ni bzhi po thams cad du rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i sgo ba bzhi po bri bar bya'o/ /rta babs kyi khyams te sgo nyis sbrag tu byed na dkyil 'khor nang ma'i rta babs kyi khyams dang / gcig rkyang du byed na/ dkyil 'khor gyi rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon thams cad du byams pa la sogs pa'i byang sems bcu drug bri bar bya zhing / de bzhin du nyan thos rgyal ba bcu drug po thams cad dang /

rang rgyal gtso bo bcu gnyis po rnams dang / khro bo mngags pa pho nya la sogs pa bcu drug po rnams sku yongs su rdzogs pa bri bar bya ba'am yang na ming tsam yang rung ngo / /gzhan phan nyer mkho las byang sems bcu drug sogs sgo nyis brtsegs su byed na nang ma'i khyams su dgod la/ sgo rkyang du byed na yang lha snam che bar byed la rim pa gnyis su bya/ nang ma la rtsa ba'i lha so bdun/ phyi ma la mgron thabs kyi lha drug cu dgod ces gsung ngo / /yang ces pa'i sgras ni/ spyi chings las yang lte ba ni de nyid yin la/ 'khor lo dang 'khor lo'i mu khyud la cha chen gnyis btang la/ lha snam gyi lha tshogs rta babs kyi g.yas g.yon du dgod pa yin te zhes gsungs pa sdud de/ lugs gnyis 'dam kha can du bzhed par mngon no/ /phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol khor yug tu gling bzhi po ni bri bar bya'o/ /lhor 'dzam bu gling du tshangs pa ser po padma thogs pa/ chung ma tshangs ma dbyangs can gnyis 'khor tshangs pa brgyad dang bcas pa bri'o/ /byang sgra mi snyan du ni dbang phyug chen po mdung rtse gsum thogs pa/ 'khor chung ma brgyad de u ma sngo/ gha gha dkar/ ya ma na ljang / dmar mo ser/ 'jigs byed ma dkar/ ljang gi lha mo dmar/ stobs bzang ma dkar/ ku mā ri dmar skya bde ba'i lag cha 'dzin pa bri'o/ /shar gyi lus 'phags gling du ni/ brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa rdo rje 'dzin pa/ thig le 'dzin sha rtsi dang / thig le mchog gnyis dkar mo'o/ /nub ba glang spyod du ni/ gtogs 'dod ste khyab 'jug sngon po btsun mo nor rgyun ma dang / dbyangs can gnyis dkar ser te thams cad kyang 'khor dang bcas te bri bar bya ba'i don ni bshad zin to/ /bzhi po las gzhan dag kyang ni de bzhin du khor yug tu bri bar bya ste/ nub phyogs su lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags bzangs ris sngon po 'khor dang bcas pa/

shar phyogs su dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa chung ma gnyis/ pho nya gnyis te bzhi/ byang stod du nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gser mig can chung ma dang bcas pa phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis na gandhe dang bgrang phreng / g.yon gnyis padma dang mchog sbyin/ byang phyogs su gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po la rgyal ba khyu mchog dang / yang dag shes dang / lngas rtsen gyis bskor ba ne'u le dang bi dza pu ra 'dzin pa ser po'o/ /lto 'phye ni nub tu klu'i rgyal po sbrul mgo bdun pa dang / mi'am ci'i rgyal po ljon pa rta mgo can no/ /srin po che ni lho nub tu srin po nag po mi la zhon pa'o/ /'byung po ni byang shar du dbang phyug dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa'o/ /yi dwags ni 'chi bdag nag po ste ma he la zhon pa dbyig pa can no/ /klu ni klu chen brgyad de khor yug gi nub phyogs su bri zhing kha dog dang lag cha ni 'og 'jig rten pa'i skabs su 'byung ngo / /grul bum rlig po che pho nya mo dang bcas pa nag po dang / ri rnams dang zhes pa'i ni ri brgyad ston no/ /phyogs bzhir rgyal po bzhi bri bar bya zhing gza' brgyad dang skar ma gzhan rnams dang / rgyu skar nyer brgyad phyogs rer bdun bdun te de dag gi phyag mtshan yang 'og tu 'byung ngo / /khro bo ni shar du gdon gyi bdag po sngo skya/ ma rungs 'tshe ba ni/ lhor rdo rje mchu dang / rdo rje sprin gnyis smug po/ nub tu sprin gyi sgrol ma dmar mo rdo rje rtse gsum dang sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /bgegs kyi rgyal po byi na ya ga ni glang sna dkar po g.yas bgrang phreng dang la phug g.yon dgra satwa dang la du'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /gong du bshad pa de rnams kyang sangs rgyas kyi ye shes nyid gdul bya'i don du de dang de'i skur ston pas na sems can kun la phan par byed pa ste/ 'dis ni 'jig rten pa rang rgyud par 'dod pa bkag go

/drang srong skal ba chen po rnams kyi gzugs ni shar lhor rgyas pa dang / gar mkhan gyi bu la sogs pa ci rigs par bri bar bya ste/ sku mdog dang lag cha la nges pa med do/ /phra men ma ni/ lho nub tu gau rī dang tsau rī dang / ma taṃ ki la sogs pa ci rigs par bris te/ kha dog dang lag cha la nges pa med do/ /bud med ni tsa munti dang / ri'u ti ma la sogs pa gzhung gang yang rung ba nas 'byung ba bzhin bri'o/ /de bzhin du nub byang du sring mo bzhi ni 'dod pa ma nag mo/ phag mo dkar mo rdo rje thod pa 'dzin pa'o/ /thod pa mo dmar mo lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ grub ma ljang khu bgrang phreng 'dzin pa/ de'i rtsar ming po gsum rgyal bar byed pa ljang khu dril bu 'dzin pa/ sbrang rtsir byed pa dkar po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ don kun grub par byed pa dmar po lcags sgrogs 'dzin pa'o/ /byang shar du rnal 'byor ma bzhi ni srin mo nag mo thod pa 'dzin pa/ be con ma dkar mo be con 'dzin pa/ mtshan mo nag mo dgra satwa 'dzin pa/ gnod sbyin ma nag mo mche ba 'dzin pa'o/ /'byung ba bzhi'i lha chen po ni/ sa'i lha mo ser mo bum pa 'dzin pa/ chu lha dkar po zhags pa 'dzin pa/ me lha dmar po ra la zhon pa/ rlung lha ljang khu sha ba la zhon pa'o/ /khyim gyi lha ni/ phyug lha glang zhon dkar/ lam gyi lha rta zhon khram thogs sngo/ khyim la brten pa dmar skya'o/ /ri la gnas pa ni ri'i lha'o/ /shing lha ni shing gseb na ljang / kun dga'i lha ni skyed shing gseb na dmar/ ljongs kyi lha ni ljongs chen po la brten pa ni sogs kyis bsdus pa'o/ /dur khrod na gnas pa ni 'dre nag po'o/ /grong khyer na gnas pa ni grong na gnas pa'o/ /de rnams kyi sku phyag rgya chen po'am/ ming ngam/ brda ste tshom bu'am/ yang na ni thig le rnams kyang bri bar bya'o/ /lnga pa mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa ni/ de nas mkhas pas dkyil 'khor la/ /zhes sogs so/

/gzhan rnams ni go sla la/ brgyad dam bcu drug lhag kyang rung / /ces pas mchod bum dang / bum pa lnga ni bzhag par bya/ /zhes pas dbang bum dang / mar me gtor ma bum pa dang / /zhes pa'i bum pas ni nye bar mkho ba'i bum pa bstan no/ /gnod sbyin srin po'i kha zas su/ /gtor ma rnam pa sna tshogs bzhag /ces pas bgegs gtor dang / 'byung po dag dang zhes pas ni phyogs skyong sogs spyir bstan la/ klu dag dang zhes sogs kyis 'byung po'i gtor ma bstan/ rnam rgyal bum pa ni go sla'o/ /drug pa zhugs te bsgrub pa la bzhi ste/ slob dpon bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sgo drung du 'dug pa/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs te bsgrub pa/ mchod pa dang bstod pa/ gtor ma gtong ba'o/ /dang po ni/ mchod gtor sogs bshams zin pa'i rjes de nas/ khrus dang la sogs pas chas gos kyis brgyan par byas la dri zhim pos byugs pa dang / me tog gi phreng ba mchog gi phreng ba can du byas pa dang / dri zhim po'i chus kha bkang ste mchog tu mdzes par byas nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor gyi khang par bzhugs nas kyang me tog thogs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo'i phyogs su 'dug go /'dir snur pa bris pa'i rjes de nyid la/ dkyil 'khor ma bsgrubs par 'jug pa'i chos rnams len no zhes zer de ni mi 'thad de/ dkyil 'khor ma bsgrub par 'jug pa la don med pa'i phyir dang / 'khor los sgyur ba'i skabs nas kyang / /de nas sngags mkhan bdag nyid kyis/ /spyan drangs bdag nyid 'jug par bya/ /bdag nyid la ni dbang yang bskur/ /zhes 'byung ba dang 'gal ba'i phyir ro/ /des na kha'u pa/ sgrub mchod byas nas 'jug pa len/ /'o na 'dir rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs ces pa dang mi 'gal lam zhe na/ de ni dkyil 'khor gyi sgo drung du phyag rgya bcas te 'dug pa tsam la dgongs zhes gsungs pa 'di nyid 'thad pa'i phyogs yin no/

/gnyis pa ni/ gtso bo rgya ba sras kyi 'khor/ /zhes sogs te/ rgyud 'dir mdun bskyed bsgrub pa'i gong du bdag bskyed dngos su ma gsungs kyang / 'og ras bris kyi skabs su/ bdag gi de nyid dran byed cing / /zhes pas bdag bskyed zin la/ 'og nas sngags mkhan zhes pas kyang bdag bskyed bstan pas mchod pa byin dbab sngon du song nas/ bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung bsgoms te/ sta gon ma byas na skabs 'dir bum pa'i bzlas pa yang byas la mdun bskyed bsgrub pa la 'jug go /'dir rgyas bsdus gnyis las/ rgyas par byed na shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis dkyil 'khor stong par bsams/ oṃ bha zhes pas 'byung ba rim brtsegs kyi steng du gzhal yas khang gdan bcas bskyed nas brten pa lha rnams snying po tshig tsam gyis bskyed pa'am spro bsdu las bskyed pa gang rung bya'o/ /bsdus pa ni bris pa'i dkyil 'khor nyid la ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ste rgyud kyi dngos bstan la 'di nyid gsal lo/ /gang ltar yang 'di man chad 'dra ba nyid yin pas spyan drang zhes pa bshad pa'i gzhir bzhag nas gang na gtso bo ni rtsa ba'i lha so bdun/ sras ni/ mgron thabs kyi lha/ 'khor ni 'jig rten pa'o/ /rtsa skya pas ni gtso bo ni kun rig rgyal ba de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi/ sras ni yum bzhi nas sgo bzhi'i bar/ 'khor ni bskal bzang nyan rang / mang po rnams ni khor yug gi 'jig rten pa'i lha grangs mang ba'o zhes bshad de spyan drang ba'o/ /rnal 'byor gang gis na rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya dang / sngags dang sgrub pa po 'di nyid ldan zhing rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa spro ba'i rnal 'byor gyis so/ /rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs thugs rje'i bdag /tshur gshegs zhes ni brjod nas kyang / /zhes pa ste/ shāka thub kyi skabs nas 'byung ba'i sngags de nyid do/ /lcags kyu sogs kyi phyag rgya gang zhe na/

gsang ba'i bcing ba bcings nas ni/ /zhes sogs te/ dgug gzhug bcing / dbang du byas nas rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pa ni/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa ste/ dam tshig pa la ye shes pa 'jug pa de nas ras bris kyi skabs nas bstan pa'i mtshan ma skyes nas ni/ chos kyi dbyings thog mar mthong ba nas/ tha ma rdzogs kyi bar mngon sum du mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa ni/ arghaṃ ni/ mchod yon te/ des mtshon pa'i me tog la sogs pa lnga mi rtog pas zin pas mchog tu brtags pa'o/ /gsang ba ni lha mo brgyad/ sogs kyi sgras bsdus pa ni/ rdo rje rtse mo bzhin ngo mtshar ba'i mchod pa bco brgyad dang / 'di nyid nas 'byung ba'i mchod pa nyi shu rtsa lnga'o/ /dbyangs snyan pa'i bstod pa ni mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa'am/ dkyil chog rnams nas 'byung ba'i lha so so'i mchod bstod ci nus pa'o/ /lha rdzas mchog gi dam pa ni/ rin chen sna bdun dang / 'dod yon lnga'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ phyogs na gnas pa rnams la rnam par brtag ces pa yar drangs te phyogs skyong gi gtor ma dang / de nas 'byung po kun gyi gtor ma bya/ /zhes pas 'byung po'i gtor ma sngar bshad pa'i bgegs gtor dang gsum po de'i gtor ma dpung bzangs la sogs pa nas bshad pa ltar mthun par bya'o/ /sems can bkres shing skoms la btung ba dang / /zhes pa ni rigs drug dang / yi dwags kyi gtor ma'o/ /gnyis pa slob ma mjug cing dbang bskur ba la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skabs 'dir slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ma gsungs kyang / 'og phyogs skyong dang / tshe dpag med dang / 'khor los sgyur ba'i skabs nas 'byung ba ltar bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang / mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa dang / bdag mdun tha mi dad du bsgrub pa'i rjes de nas sngags pa rdo rje slob dpon gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi sems sa bcu gcig pa 'byung ba'i gnas/

dkyil 'khor du slob ma rnams yongs su smin par bya'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ 'jug pa dang / dbang ngo / /dang po la slob ma lhag par gnas pa/ sems bskyed pa/ slob ma 'jug pa/ dam tshig bsgrag pa sngon du song nas sdom pa 'bogs pa gsum du gsungs kyang / gzhan phan 'od zer las 'jug pa'i chos bcu bdun gsungs pa ltar bshad na/ sems bskyed gtso bor gyur pa'i rgyun bshags bya ba dang / byin gyis brlab pa dang / smon lam gdab pa dang / zab mo'i chos bshad pa dang / bsrung ba bya ba dang / gdong g.yogs bcing ba dang / phyag rgya bcings nas 'jug pa dang / ye shes dbab pa dang / dam la bzhag pa dang / me tog dor ba dang / mgo la bcing ba dang / gdong g.yogs dbye ba dang / dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang / dam tshig bskyed pa dang / dam tshig brtan par bya ba dang / dam tshig bsgrag pa dang / sdom pa sbyin pa dang bcu bdun las/ dang po ni/ 'gro la phan phyir myur du byang chub bar zhes pa ste rdo rje 'byung ba ltar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed pa dang nang gi sems bskyed pa dang / rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de rnams byin brlab zhes pa ste/ rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab pa dang / oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭha zhes sogs dang / rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis gnas nyi shu rtsa gnyis su byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /gsum pa ni/ byang chub smon lam gdab ces pa ste/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ zab cing rgya che ba'i chos bsgrags la zhes pa ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las 'byung ba bzhin/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /zhes sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ bsrung ba byas nas zhes pa ste/ /me ltar 'bar ba'i sngags dang / phyag rgyas lan gsum bsrung ba'o/ /sa chog gi rjes su bri ba ma grub na sta gon byed par gsungs pa ltar na nub snga ma la byed dgos pas/ so shing /

ku sha/ srung skud gsum 'dis zin to/ /drug pa ni/ slob ma mi dge ba bcu spangs pa'i brtul zhugs kyi sdom pa la gnas pa sems bskyed pas rab tu zhi ba de rang gi kha nas sngags brjod pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor du gzhug par bya zhes mdor bstan nas/ thog mar dar ram/ ras la sogs pa'i mig gnyis g.yogs nas ni zhes pa'o/ /bdun pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dpal gyi lag gnyis bya/ /zhes pa ste/ de'i sngags ni/ oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭha hūm̐/ zhes pa'o/ /me tog rin chen la sogs pas slob ma'i lus de brgyan la/ bla ma la 'bul ba'i yon gyis lag pa bkang ste gzhug par bya/ de'i sngags ni/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ zhes pa'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ oṃ badzra pra bhe sha ya hūm̐ zhes pa ste/ rdo rje phob shig ces pa'i don no/ /dgu pa ni/ a sa me ni skye ba med pa/ tri sa me ni sku gsung thugs/ mahā sa ma ye ni dam tshig chen po/ hūm̐ ni sdus shig pa'o/ /bcu pa ni/ de nas sngags 'dis zhes sogs te go sla'o/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ oṃ badzra pra tītstsha badzra sa ma ya satwaṃ zhes pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje'i skabs nas/ oṃ badzra ha se ud ga ṭa ya hūm̐ zhes pa'o/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ phyag rdor nas/ oṃ badzra pa shyā ho zhes pas dkyil 'khor bstan nas/ me tog rin chen la sogs pa zhes sogs te go sla'o/ /bcu bzhi pa ni/ de nas sngags la mkhas pa yis/ /zhes sogs so/ /bco lnga pa ni/ /oṃ ni bshad zin badzra sa ma ya ni rdo rje dam tshig hṛ da ya mi ni snying la/ pra bhe shā ni phab nas ḍiḍha tiṣṭha ni gnas shing brtan pa'o/ /bcu drug pa ni/ de nas 'dis zhes sogs te/ bdun brgyud rigs ni kha'u pa mar gyi rgyud bu tsha la sogs pa la byed/ snur pa sgrub pa po ma gtogs pa yar gyi bdun brgyud de pha mes la sogs pa bdun brgyud la byed do/ /bcu bdun pa ni/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /zhes sogs so/

/'dir dge bsnyen gyi bslab gzhi lnga bsrung dgos par gsungs shing / rdo rje rtse mo las kyang de ltar gsungs pas sngags pa khyim pa yin na yang dge bsnyen gyi bslab gzhi lnga nges par bsrung dgos zhes bla ma mus pa chen po gsungs shing / rtsa ltung 'khrul spong dang mngon rtogs ljon shing gi dgongs pa yang 'di nyid du snang ngo / /gdon gyi las sogs bya ba min ni rang gi dngos grub la bar chad mi byed na/ gzhan gyi 'dre rgod gzir ba dang / phur bus gdab pa sogs mi bya'o/ /mu stegs can la yang smad par mi bya ste/ rnam snang mngon byang las/ rnam par snang mdzad ring ba'i rgyur gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /mdor na spang blang gi dam tshig la yid gnyis dang som nyi dang the tshom mi bya ste/ der ma zad bdag gi de kho na nyid dang / sngags kyi de kho na nyid dang / sogs kyis sgras bsdus pa de dag ston pa'i bla ma la yang de bzhin du yid gnyis sogs mi bya'o/ /gnyis pa dbang la gnyis te/ dbang bskur ba dang / rjes bla ma la mchod pa phan yon dang bcas pa bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slob ma sngar gyi dam tshig de dag la mos pa brtan po dang ldan pas dam tshig bsrung bar dam bcas nas/ dbang gi dngos gzhi bskur bar bya'i/ dam tshig bsrung mi nus pa ni 'jug pa tsam byas nas btang ngo / /de'ang tshe ldan gyi dbang du byas kyis/ tshe 'das la ni dbang mtha' dag bskur bar gsungs so/ /'dis tshe 'das la dbang bskur ba ni sdig pa sbyong ba'i thabs tsam yin gyis sdom pa skye ba ma yin par gsal lo/ /dbang gi dngos gzhi ji ltar bskur na/ 'di la sngags kyi dbang bum pa la sogs kyi dbang bcu/ thabs shes rab kyi dbang / rin chen sna bdun gyi dbang ste bcu dgu yod pa las/ dang po ni/ sarba bid kyis sngar sngags kyi phreng ba'i skabs su bshad pa ci bzhin gyi dbang bskur ste/ rtsa rig la sogs pa sngags bcu gsum mo/ /de nas bum pa la sogs pa'i dbang rdzas ji snyed pa mang po ste bcu thogs pas bum pa la sogs pa bcu po rnams kyi dbang bcu ci dgar bskur te/
