thig le 'dzin sha rtsi dang / thig le mchog gnyis dkar po'o/ /lhor oṃ ya las gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa dbyug pa thogs pa/ re ma ti lag cha sna tshogs pa nag po/ nub tu oṃ baṃ las chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ byang du oṃ ku las gnod sbyin ser po rta la zhon pa rin po che 'dzin pa/ byang shar du oṃ i las dbang phyug dkar po glang la zhon pa rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ shar lhor oṃ a las me lha dmar po ra la zhon pa dbyug gu 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu oṃ ri las srin po nag po mi la zhon pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du oṃ/ aṃ las rlung lha ljang khu shwa ba la zhon pa ba dan 'dzin pa/ lhor oṃ a las nyi ma dmar po rta la zhon pa nyi ma 'dzin pa/ byang du oṃ swa las zla ba dkar po ngang pa la zhon pa zla ba 'dzin pa/ byang shar du oṃ bra las sa bdag phag mgo can ser po phag la zhon pa pi waṃ 'dzin pa'o zhes rje btsun bzhed la/ rtsa skya pas gzhan 'dra ba las/ oṃ a las/ gtso bo'i mdun du tshangs pa dkar po phyag bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na glegs bam dang phreng ba/ g.yon mchog sbyin dang bum pa 'dzin cing ngang pa chibs nas/ g.yas su nyi ma dmar po padma nyi mas brgyan pa 'dzin pa dang / g.yon du zla ba dkar po ku mu ta bsnams pa'o/ /oṃ bri las gtso bo'i rgyab tu sa'i lha mo ser mo bum pa 'dzin cing phag la chibs nas/ g.yas su lha ma yin nag po go cha 'dzin pa/ g.yon du klu dkar po sbrul thogs pa can bskyed do/ /zhes bzhed do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma 'jug cig dbang bskur ba'i cho ga'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / zhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas spyan drangs te kun la/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ slob ma rnams ni gzhug pa'i phyir/ /zhes sogs so/

/gsum pa ni/ de la phan par 'dod pa yis/ /zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa la gnyis te/ spyir khas blangs pa dang / bye brag tu khas blangs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas/ de dag mgu nas 'di skad ces gsol te zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas chos kyi rgyal po gshin rjes zhes sogs te/ brgya byin dang me lha gnyis kyis khas blangs pa mi snang ngo / /gsum pa gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba dang / sgrub pa dang / bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas gza' chen po brgyad dang 'khor rgyu skar dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang zhes sogs te/ rtsa skya pas phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zlum por cha chen gcig gi tshad bskor ba'i dbus le tshe dgur phye ba'i dbus kyi pad nyi la rtsa rig dang / me nyi ma'i sngags kyis khams gsum rnam rgyal bskyed par bzhed la/ rje btsun gyis/ shar du oṃ shū las pa wa sangs dkar po stan nang tshangs can la 'dug pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa shing thog thogs pa/ lhor oṃ bri las phur bu dkar po zla ba la gnas pa g.yas po ti g.yon chos 'chad pa'i tshig 'dren pa'i tshul/ stod g.yogs ser po can no/ /nub tu oṃ swa las zla ba dkar po utpa la thogs pa ngang pa la zhon pa/ byang du oṃ phu las gza' lhag ser po g.yas mchog sbyin g.yon utpa la 'dzin la/ stan nang tshangs can no/ /rlung du oṃ a las nyi ma dmar po rta la zhon pa ya lad gyon pa lag na padma 'dzin pa'o/ /dbang ldan du oṃ swa las spen pa mdog nag po rgyan med pa/ skra bshig pa/ dbyug tho thogs pa stan nang tshangs can no/ /shar lhor oṃ aṃ las mig dmar mdog dmar po g.yas bum pa chus gang ba/ g.yon mgal me 'dzin pa stan nang tshangs can no/ /srin por oṃ a ra las sgra gcan mdog dud kha bzhin khros pa mche ba gtsigs pa/

skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ rked pa man chad sbrul sprin gseb na 'dug pa de dag ni le dgu'i phyogs mtshams brgyad do/ /de'i phyi rol gyi lha snam la phyogs re rer rgyu skar bdun bdun gnas pa ni/ shar du smin drug dmar po bum pa la gnas pa/ snar ma ljang khu ba dkar mo la zhon pa/ mgo ser po shwa ba la zhon pa/ lag dmar po sbrul la zhon pa/ nams so dmar po padma la 'dug pa/ rgyal ljang khu bum pa la 'dug pa/ skag ljang khu bya rog la zhon pa/ lho ru mchu ser po me tog la 'dug pa/ bre dkar po padmo la 'dug pa/ dbo ljang khu khri la 'dug pa/ me bzhi ser po glang la zhon pa/ nag pa ljang khu rma bya la zhon pa/ sa ri dmar po spyang mo la zhon pa/ sa ga ljang khu ra dkar po la zhon pa/ nub tu lha mtshams ser po bya rog la zhon pa/ snron dmar po stan nang tshangs can la 'dug pa/ snrubs ljang khu rus sbal la zhon pa/ chu stod ser po stan nang tshangs can la 'dug pa/ chu smad ljang khu mi'i snying la 'dug pa/ byi bzhin dkar po stan nang tshangs can la 'dug pa/ gro zhun ser po mon skud la 'dug pa/ byang du mon gru dmar po stan nang tshangs can la 'dug pa/ mon gre ljang khu ba la zhon pa/ khrums stod ljang khu gser khri la 'dug pa/ khrums smad ser po gser khri la 'dug pa/ nam gru dmar po rta la zhon pa/ tha skar ljang khu mi'i snying la 'dug pa/ bra nye ser po 'khor lo la 'dug pa'o/ /sgo bzhir sgo ba bzhi khros pa'o/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma 'jug cing dbang bskur ba'i las so/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / zhugs te sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje 'dzin mas zhugs nas ni/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob ma rnams gzhug ste/ /zhes sogs so/ /dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang dam tshig pa bskyed pa dang /

me tog dor ba'i sngags gsum ni khyad par ro/ /gsum pa ni/ gza' thams cad sgrub par bya'o zhes pa ste gtso bo'i sngags la btags nas bsgrub pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas gza' chen po de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa klu chen brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la gsum ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba phan yon dang bcas pa dang / dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas klu chen po brgyad kyi phuḥṭa ces bya ba'i sgras zhes sogs te/ padma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar puṇya'i sngags la phyag na rdo rje dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin par rtsa skya pas bshad la/ rje btsun gyis sngo ljang du bzhed do/ /'dab ma brgyad la shar du oṃ phu las mtha' yas sngon po/ lhor oṃ pha las 'jog po dmar po/ nub tu oṃ phuṃ las stobs kyi rgyu ljang khu/ byang du oṃ pha las rigs ldan khra bo/ shar lhor oṃ phiṃ las nor rgyas dkar po/ lho nub tu oṃ phāṃ las dung skyong ser po/ nub byang du oṃ pheṃ las padma dmar po/ byang shar du oṃ phūo las chu lha dkar po/ sbrul mgo bdun bdun gyis bskor ba chung ma'i mgul nas 'khyud pa'o/ /chung ma rnams sku mdog yab dang 'dra ba la utpa la 'dzin pa/ sbrul mgo gsum gsum gyis bskor ba yab la 'khyud pa'o/ /sgo ba bzhi ni ma bshad do/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ dbang bskur ba dang / phan yon no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / zhugs te sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas rdo rje'i bdag nyid zhugs/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas bu ni rgyal po dang / /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa phan yon ni/ de nas ming tsam brjod pas kyang /

/zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa dngos grub kyi ye shes bstan pa ni/ de nas sgrub pa bshad de/ zhes sogs so/ /lnga pa 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor la gsum ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob mar dbang bskur ba dang / dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas lha chen po rnams kyi bdag po 'jigs par byed pa chen po zhes sogs te/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar pad nyi la me nyi ma'i sngags kyis khams gsum rnam rgyal/ shar du oṃ bhai ra las 'jig byed chen po sku mdog sngo nag g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ glang po che'i ko rlon gyon pa/ dbu la thod pa zla tshes kyis brgyan pa mtshan ma btsun mo la bstan pa/ yum dbu ma oṃ bhai ra bhe swāhā las dka' thub bzlog pa'i tshul sku mdog phyag mtshan gtso bo dang 'dra/ gha ga dkar/ ya mi ni ljang / dpal mo ser/ 'jigs byed dkar/ rdzong gi lha mo dmar/ stobs bzang ma dkar/ ku mā ri dmar skya ci bde ba'i lag cha 'dzin pa'o/ /yang shar du oṃ phu swāhā/ las lha chen khros pa dkar po yum dang bcas pa'o/ /lhor oṃ bhai swāhā las brgya byin khros pa ser po yum thig le 'dzin sha rtsi dang / thig le mchog gnyis dkar mo'o/ /nub tu oṃ bhai swāhā las tshangs pa khros pa dmar po/ yum tshangs ma dang dbyangs can gnyis 'khor tshangs ma brgyad dang bcas pa/ byang du oṃ bhi swāhā las khyab 'jug khros pa sngon po/ yum nor rgyun ma dang dbyangs can gnyis ser dang dkar ba'o/ /shar lhor oṃ bhai swāhā las 'dod pa'i rgyal po khros pa dmar po yum dang bcas pa/ lho nub tu oṃ bhau swāhā las tshogs bdag khros pa dud kha yum dang bcas pa/ nub byang du oṃ bhṛ swāhā las bhṛṃ gi ri ti khros pa sngo skya chung ma dang bcas pa/ byang shar du oṃ bha swāhā las smin drug khros pa chung ma dang bcas pa'o/

/sgo bzhir sgo ba bzhi khros pa ni sngar bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / zhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas lcags kyu la sogs pas/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyis/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas las rnams sbyin bya ste/ /zhes sogs so/ /drug pa lha chen brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor la/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang / rdul mtshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang / dngos grub kyi ye shes la bslab pa dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa las dngos grub gsol bar bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa lha chen po rnams kyis/ zhes sogs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi nang du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar pad nyi la 'jig rten gsum rgyal sngar bzhin/ shar du oṃ ru las dbang phyug chen po sngo skya glang la zhon cing zla ba phyed pa'i cod paṇa can/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos u ma la 'khyud cing / gnyis pa rdo rje rtse gsum dang ldan pa'i mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang pos mdung rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas ral gri 'dzin pa'o/ /nub tu oṃ oṃ las ngang pa'i steng du tshangs pa ser po gdong bzhi pa dang / rdo rje zhi ba ma ni g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje dang bgrang phreng / g.yon gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ byang du oṃ bhi las khyab 'jug nag po dang / yum rdo rje gser ni ser mo nam mkha' lding gi steng na phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis kyis dbyug pa dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis dung dang 'khor lo 'dzin pa'o/ /lhor oṃ i las brgya byin dang / khu tshur ma ni ser skya glang chen la zhon pa g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa/

g.yon rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar lhor oṃ kaṃ las 'dod pa'i dbang phyug dkar po phyag gnyis ral gri dang gshol mda' 'dzin pa'o/ /lho nub tu oṃ ga las tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i zhal can phyag g.yas gnyis kyis rtse gsum dang la du/ g.yon gnyis kyis dgra satwa dang la phug 'dzin pa ni byi ba'i gdan la'o/ /byang shar du oṃ bhri las rdo rje gzhon nu dang / yum ni dmar mo zhal drug pa phyag g.yas gnyis kyis mdung dang rdo rje 'dzin pa/ g.yon gnyis kyis khyim bya can rma bya'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /nub byang du oṃ ka las/ bhring gi ri ti nag po rnga la zhon cing phyag gnyis kyis rnga brdung ba'o/ /sgo ba bzhi khros pa sngar gyi sa bon las bskyed pa ste lha bcu gsum mo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug cig dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa dang / zhugs te bsgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas zhugs nas lha rnams ni/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i zhes sogs te/ me tog dor ba'i sngags ni 'di'i khyad par ro/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas lha rnams gang dga' ba'i/ /zhes sogs te/ gang phyir mchog ni khyod la sbyin/ /zhes pas mchog gi dngos grub sbyin nus par bstan la/ gal te de ni thun mong gi dngos grub rnams kyi nang nas mchog tu gyur pa la dgongs so snyam na ma yin te/ lha la mchog ni gsol ba gdab/ /ces pa la sogs pa dang / lha rdzas khu ba bro brdung dang / /mi snang ba dang mkha' 'gro dang / /ril bu rdzas dang rgyal la sogs/ /yid 'dod tshad med gsol ba gdab/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas dbang phyug chen po la sogs pas zhes sogs te/ 'dir yang sgrib pa ma mchis pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o zhes pa nas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid du 'grub pa'i lam bstan par bgyi'o zhes pa'i bar gyis 'di dag 'jig rten pa rang rgyud pa yin pa bkag ste/

'jig rten pa rang rgyud pa la 'di dag bstan pa'i nus pa ga la yod/ gsum pa tshe dpag med gsung gi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ gleng bslang ba dang rgyud kyi gzhung bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ ston pas gleng bslang ba dang / 'khor gyi gleng bslang ba'o/ /dang po ni de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje nyid kyis dkyil 'khor kun tu gzigs nas zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa rgyud kyi gzhung la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma la dbang bskur ba dang / ngan song du skye ba dang skyes zin pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba dang / rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa lha rnams shin tu mang bar gyur nas zhes sogs te/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar pad zla la/ oṃ bhrūm̐ swāhā las tshe dpag med dkar dmar g.yon ting nge 'dzin can g.yas skyabs sbyin gyis bum pa 'dzin pa'o/ /shar du oṃ dhrīṃ swāhā las phyag rdor dkar ljang rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang du oṃ kruṃ swāhā las khams gsum rnam rgyal sngo skya g.yas rdo rje dbyug pa/ g.yon sdig mdzub can/ lhor oṃ traṃ swāhā las nam snying sngo skya g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ nub tu oṃ hrīḥswāhā/ las spyan ras gzigs dmar skya g.yas padma/ g.yon mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa/ bdug sogs bzhi dang / sgo ba bzhi ni kun rig bzhin te lha bcu gsum mo/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba yan lag dang bcas pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa la sogs pa dang / zhugs te sgrub pa la sogs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de/ zhes sogs te/ bum pa lnga dang brgyad ni dbang bum dang mchod bum yin la/

bdug pa la sogs ni mchod rdzas te/ las thams cad pa'i sngags kyis btab pa ni khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi sngags so/ /mchod pa la sogs pa bzhag ste zhes pa ni bdug sogs bzhi grwa bzhir dgod pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas sngags mkhan bdag nyid zhugs la zhes sogs te/ sngags mkhan zhes pa gong 'og tu mang du 'byung ba rnams kyis ni/ mdun bskyed ma bsgrub pa'i gong du bdag bskyed bsgom pa bstan snyam mo/ /'dir mdun bskyed bsgrubs pa'i rjes su bdag nyid dbang bskur zhing / mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa bya bar gsungs pa ni gong 'og kun la sbyar bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba dang / bla ma la yon dbul ba dang / dngos grub kyi ye shes dang / dbang bskur ba'i phan yon bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas rdo rje 'dzin ma'i phyag rgya bcings la zhes sogs te/ bdag 'jug gi rjes su bdag mdun tha mi dad du bsgrub tshul 'di ni 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor kun la sbyar bar bya'o/ /'dir oṃ badzra dha ra zhes sogs ni 'jug pa'i tshe me tog gzung ba'i sngags kyang yin la/ oṃ ta thā ga ta zhes sogs ni me tog 'dor 'ching gnyis ka'i sngags dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes sogs ni chu dbang gi sngags so/ /de dag dang / dam tshig dang / bka'i dbang bskur ba dang / las kyi dbang bskur ba rnams ni 'di'i khyad chos so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas bla ma bla ma'i phyir/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas byang chub bar du ni/ /zhes sogs te/ chos rnams thams cad dngos med pa/ /sems kyis bsgoms pa byas nas kyang / /zhes pas snod bcud stong nyid du bsgom pa bstan/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /zhes pas ni gdan gyi zla ba bstan la/ de'i 'og tu padma ni gleng bzhir bstan zin to/ /rang gi sa bon de dbus su/ /bsams nas zhes dang / dam tshig gi phyag rgya yang / bsam zhing zhes pas ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang /

dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gang bskyed pa de'i sa bon dang / de las phyag mtshan du gyur pa bstan/ de bzhin de nyid du zhes pas ni phyag mtshan la sa bon gyis mtshan pa bstan/ sgrub pa pos ni bsgyur bar bya/ /lha yi rnal 'byor tshul du bsgyur/ /zhes pas ni de las lha'i skur bsgom pa bstan/ de nas rang gi sa bon dang / /phyag rgyas phyag rgya de byin brlab/ /ces pas ni/ shāka thub nas 'byung ba'i sngags dang phyag rgyas/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa bstan/ ltag 'og go rim ji bzhin du/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis dbang bskur ro/ /zhes pas gnas lngar dbang bskur ba bstan no/ /'di bdag bskyed yin pa ni/ /de nas nga rgyal bskyed pa dang / /zhes pas shes so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha chen po rnams kyis zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ngan song du skye ba dang skyes zin pa'i sdig pa sbyong ba la gnyis te/ lha rnams kyis zhus pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas lha de dag gis de bzhin du phyag 'tshal nas/ zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ tshe 'das la sbyang ba dang / tshe ldan la sbyang ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ dbang bskur bas sdig pa sbyong ba dang / bzlas pas sbyang ba dang / sbyin sreg gis sbyang ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ kye lha yi bu rnams de dag ni/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ kye lha'i bu rnams ngan song du skyes zin pa zhes sogs te/ mchod rten dang rang gi lha'i sku ni rus pa la btab pa ste/ rten bskyed nas dbang bskur ba'o/ /rigs mthun pa dang bu la sogs pa ni rten bskyed du mi rung gi tshe 'das de'i ched du de dag la dbang bskur ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ lha'i bu rnams de'i ming nas smos te/ zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa la bzhi ste/ zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang dang / mngon spyod do/ /dang po ni/

lha yi bu rnams zhi ba yi/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ni bde 'gror skyes nas kyang / /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas phan phyir nges par yang / /zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ de la gdon rnams gzhom pa ni/ /zhes sogs te/ mngon par rtogs pa rnams kun rig gi skabs su bstan zin no/ /gnyis pa tshe ldan la sbyang ba ni/ go rim 'di dag nyid kyis ni/ /zhes sogs te/ ro bsreg pa dang / rus bu'i sātstsha ma gtogs pa sdig sbyong gi sgo thams cad gson po la yang 'jug par shes par bya'o/ /bzhi pa rgyud kyi che ba bstan pa la bzhi ste/ rgyud bris pa'i phan yon/ mnga' gsol ba'i phan yon/ rgyud bshad pa'i phan yon/ dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'i phan yon no/ /dang po ni/ de nas tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha'i bu rnams yid mgu nas zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ gang gis brtags pa'i rgyal po 'di dad pas zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bdag cag tshangs pa la sogs pa'i lha rnams kyis zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das dkyil 'khor du zhugs te/ dbang bskur ba gang lags pa de dag kyang zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa 'khor los sgyur ba yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob mar dbang bskur ba dang / dngos grub kyi ye shes dang / phyag rgya'i ye shes so/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes gsang sngags dang / rig pa dang / zhes sogs te/ gzhal yas khang gi nang du 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa sngon po'i phyir lha snam rim pa brgyad byas pa'i dbus kyi pad zla la/ oṃ bhrūm̐ dhrum̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa'am/ oṃ badzra pā ṇi hrīḥta tiṣṭa hūm̐ las kun bzang ser po rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa'am/ oṃ hūm̐ a las bde ba chen po dmar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa gang mos su bskyed/ shar du oṃ badzra hūm̐ phaṭa las phyag na rdo rje dkar ser rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/

lhor oṃ dhri ḍa badzra hūm̐ phaṭa las rdo rje rin chen ser po ratna 'dzin pa/ nub rtsibs la oṃ badzra hūm̐ hrīḥlas rdo rje chos dmar skya pad sdong 'dzin pa/ byang du oṃ badzra hūm̐ a las rdo rje las ljang ser phyag g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ lha snam gnyis pa'i phyogs bzhir sems dpa' bcu drug kun rig bzhin bskyed/ sgo ba bzhi yang bskyed de rtsa ba'i lha nyer lngar rtsa skya pa bzhed la/ 'dzim pa rin sher ni sgeg sogs brgyad kyang 'dod pa ni gzhung na mi gsal lo/ /mgron thabs kyi lha ni/ lha snam dang po la sangs rgyas rab bdun/ shāka thub dang brgyad bri gsung yang / shākya thub pa nyid bdun gyi khongs su gtogs pas dpe ma dag pa 'dra'o/ /rtsa skya pa dang / 'dzim pas sangs rgyas rab bdun/ rigs lnga dang bcu gnyis phyogs re rer bkod/ shar du rnam snang mi bskyod pa/ rnam gzigs des 'gre'o/ /gsum pa la bskal bzang bcu drug bzhi pa la nyan thos bcu drug rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ lnga pa la lha chen brgyad/ drug pa la gza' brgyad rgyu skar dang bcas pa'o/ /bdun pa la rgyal po bzhi dang klu chen po brgyad bri/ brgyad pa la phyogs skyong bcu/ grwa bzhi'i shar lho dmyal ba/ srin por bya/ rlung du phag 'byung por rtsangs pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa la sogs pa dang / zhugs te sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas de dag gi dkyil 'khor bshad de zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas sngags mkhan nyid kyis ni/ /zhes sogs te/ 'dir spyan drangs pa'i rjes su slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba gsal lo/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid dang / gzhug cing dbang bskur ba dngos dang / bla ma la yon dbul zhing bka' nod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sdom gnas dam tshig ldan pa dang /

/zhes sogs te/ slob ma'i mtshan nyid 'di ni gong 'og kun tu shes par bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ sngags 'di yis/ byang chub tu sems bskyed la/ zhes sogs te/ ye shes dbab pa'i sngags ni gzhan dang thun mong ba yin la/ gzhan rnams ni 'di'i khyad chos so/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas bdag gi lus la sogs pa/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa dngos grub kyi ye shes la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas las thams cad byed du gzhug cing zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gnyis te/ rang don dang gzhan don bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bde bas bde ba bskyed na ni/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa la lnga ste/ phrin las bzhi mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa dang / sems dpa' bcu drug gi las tshogs dang / phrin las bzhi'i mjug sdud bstan pa dang / 'khor gyis legs so byin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas las rnams bshad bya ste/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa' bdag sgyur la/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dren pa kun tu bzang po yis/ /zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ bzlas dang sbyin sreg las rnams kyis/ /zhes sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal nas zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa phyag rgya'i ye shes la bslab pa la gnyis te/ mdor bstan pa dang / rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ lag pa byin gyis brlab pa dang / phyag rgya bcing thabs dngos dang / zhar las byung ba sngags bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lag pa gnyis mdun du bzhag la zhes sogs te/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams yin par mos pa bskyed de zhes pa yan chad kyis lag pa byin gyis brlab pa bstan/ chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa dang / zhes pas gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba bstan te/ a nu n+ya/ zhes pa bod skad du bsgyur ba la chos thams cad gcig la gcig 'dres pa zhes 'byung ba'i phyir ro/

/bdag dang yang rjes su mthun par bya ste/ zhes pas ni bdag bskyed dngos bstan nam snyam/ rtsa skya pas ni de gnyis char gyis gzugs brnyan gyi sbyor ba dang / rdo rje rtse mo nas bshad pa'i sdig pa dral ba dang / ye shes dbab cing brtan pa rnams gsungs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ lag pa gnyis padma 'dra bar sbyar bar byas nas/ zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ sa bcu drug ba bcu drug dza bcu drug twa bcu drug rnams so sor sbyar na badzra satwa 'byung la/ hūm̐ la sogs pa'i sa bon bcu drug dang sbyar ba'i tshe/ badzra sa twa hūm̐ badzra sa twa dzaḥl sogs pa bcu drug tu 'gyur ba ni sems dpa' bcu drug gi snying po dang / 'byin sngags su rtsa skya pa bzhed la/ rje btsun gyis sems dpa' bcu drug gi zhal phyag de nyid 'dus pa ltar bya dgos pas/ sngags kyang de nyid 'dus pa ltar bya dgos par dgongs nas gzhan phan 'od zer du de ltar gsungs la/ 'dir badzra satwa hūm̐ zhes pa la sogs pa yi ge lnga'i mtha' brten du sham ṭa dang / ghu dang / hoḥtaṃ dang / kha ṭāṃ rnams sbyar ba'i tshe las bzhi'i rol mo brdung ba'i sngags su bzhed do/ /yum bzhi'i sngags kun rig gi gnas skabs su sbyar dgos pa la bltas na snga ma rnams sems dpa' bcu drug gi bzlas sngags su byas kyang nyes pa med dam snyam mo/ /lnga pa me ltar 'bar ba'i phrin las kyi dkyil 'khor la gnyis te/ lha rnams kyis zhus pa dang / phyag na rdo rjes bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas lha rnams kun mgu nas/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa la bzhi ste/ sngags kyi phreng ba dang / rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du slob mar dbang bskur ba dang / sgrub pa dang / phrin las bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rjes/ rang gi sku zhi ba de bor te rdo rje sems dpa' khro bo me nyi ma zhes bya ba'i skur zhugs nas zhes sogs so/ /'dis phyag na rdo rje 'jig rten gsum rgyal du bsgyur nas/

oṃ badzra satwa kro dha sogs kyi sngags phyung bar gsungs pas srung 'khor bsdus pa'i skabs su 'di ltar nyams su len pa ni rgyud kyi dgongs pa bla na med pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor sgrub tshul ni/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu gnyis pa rtsibs rten dang bcas pa'i dbus kyi pad nyi la/ badzra satwa kro dha sogs kyis 'jig rten gsum rgyal bskyed de/ shar rtsibs su oṃ trai lo ka ka ra hūm̐ phaṭa las 'jig rten gsum snang / lhor oṃ trai lo ka da ma ka hūm̐ phaṭa las gsum 'dul/ nub tu oṃ trai lo ka na shā ya hūm̐ phaṭa las gsum 'jig byang du oṃ trai lo ka ban dha hūm̐ phaṭa las gsum 'ching / de bzhi'i g.yas rtsibs la rim par oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa las dbang ldan du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ oṃ ka la daṇḍa hūm̐ phaṭa las me ru dbyug sngon can/ oṃ ka ni du ni hūm̐ phaṭa las srin por mi g.yo ba/ oṃ hrīḥtri hūm̐ phaṭa las rlung du rta mgrin/ g.yon rtsibs la rim par oṃ ka la rakṣa sī hūm̐ phaṭa las dus kyi bdug pa ma/ oṃ ka la dan ti dun ti hūm̐ phaṭa las srin por me tog ma/ oṃ ka la rakṣi hūm̐ phaṭa las rlung du mar me ma/ oṃ ka la yakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa las byang shar du dus kyi gnod sbyin mo'o/ /zhes rtsa skya pas bzhed la/ rje btsun gyis de bzhi rim pa bzhin/ dus kyi srin mo/ dus kyi dbyug pa ma/ dus kyi mtshan mo/ dus kyi gnod sbyin mor bzhed de sngags don la de nyid gsal lo/ /oṃ ka la aṃ ku sha hūm̐ phaṭa las shar sgor lcags kyu/ oṃ ka la pā sha hūm̐ phaṭa las lho sgor zhags pa/ oṃ ka la ban dha hūm̐ phaṭa las nub sgor lcags sgrog oṃ ka la rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa las byang sgor dus kyi 'bebs pa ste/ de rnams thams cad sku mdog sngo nag zhal phyag mtha' yas pa khro bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i ro'i gdan la zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum ste/ gri gug dang thod pa la sogs pa'i mtshon chas rgyu ma drangs nas zhal du gsol ba'o/

/gnyis pa la gnyis te/ slob dpon gyi las dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur ba'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ bri zhing lha dgod pa la sogs pa dang / zhugs te sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas dkyil 'khor mi bzad pa/ /zhes sogs te sngar gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i skur zhugs nas zhes pa khro bo yin pa gzhung 'dis shes so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob dpon bdag nyid ces sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ de nas slob ma bsdus nas zhes sogs te/ sngags brgyaṃd ni rim pa ltar dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang / dam la gzhag pa dang / phreng ba dor ba dang / mig dbye ba dang / dkyil 'khor bstan pa dang / dam tshig brtan par byed pa dang / chu'i dbang bskur ba'i sngags yin la/ de bzhin du dbang bskur bar bya'o/ /zhes pas ni dbang bskur lhag ma rnams bstan no/ /gsum pa ni/ de nas de dag gi sgrub pa bshad de zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa la gsum ste/ zhi ba dang / rgyas pa dang / dbang ngo / /dang po la bcu ste/ thab khung dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa dang / phyogs kyi shis pa sngon du song nas lha'i rnal 'byor dang / sgrub pa po'i chas dang bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par dang / yam shing dang bu shing gi khyad par dang / bu shing la me sbar ba sngon du song nas me lha'i khyad par bstan pa dang / me lha dang / ye shes kyi lha la sbyin sreg bya ba dngos dang / bsgrub bya la bsrung ba dang / gshegs su gsol ba'i cho ga dang / ma grub na bskyar ba'i cho ga bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas khung bu gsum la rnam gcig ni/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ dri zhim chus bkang mdog 'od dkar gyur la/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ kha ni shar phyogs bltas te sbyin sreg bya/ /zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ gos la sogs pa phreng ba dkar gyis brgyan/ /zhes sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ 'dab bdun 'bras bu me tog rnams/ /zhes sogs so/ /drug pa ni/

bud shing de las byung ba'i me/ /zhes sogs so/ /bdun pa ni/ de nas de ltar bsams nas kyang / /zhes sogs so/ /brgyad pa ni/ de yi lus la dbang bskur zhing / /zhes sogs so/ /dgu pa ni/ mjug tu mngon par mchod nas ni/ /zhes sogs so/ /bcu pa ni/ ci ste de ni sdig can nam/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa rgyas pa la bcu gcig ste/ sbyin sreg gi gnas dang / thab dang dkyil 'khor bri ba dang / mchod pa'i rdzas dgod pa dang / sgrub pa'i chos dang phyogs kyi shis pa sngon du song bas lha'i rnal 'byor bya ba dang / ting nge 'dzin dang bzlas brjod kyi khyad par dang / mchod pa dang / yam shing dang bud shing gi khyad par dang / bsreg rdzas kyi khyad par dang / me lha la sbyin sreg bya ba dang / ye shes kyi lha la sbyin sreg bya ba dang dbang bskur ba dang / bsrung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ da ni rgyas pa'i las bshad de/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ khru do'am yang na khru bzhi pa'am/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ bum pa kha dog gser 'dra zhing / /zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ bdag nyid gos dang rgyan rnams dang / /zhes sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ lha yi yid bzhin nor rgyal mtshan/ /zhes sogs so/ /drug pa ni/ dung dang pi waṃ cang te'u dang / /zhes sogs so/ /bdun pa ni/ thab khung khyad par nyid las kyang / /zhes sogs so/ /brgyad pa ni/ 'bru rnams thams cad 'byor pa dang / /zhes sogs so/ /dgu pa ni/ me lha gser dang 'dra ba la/ /zhes sogs so/ /bcu pa ni/ de yi lus la khro rgyal po/ /zhes sogs so/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ de nas mjug tu 'od zer gyis/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa dbang la bcu gsum ste/ lha dang bsam pa bstan pa dang / gnas dang thab khung gi khyad par dang / yam shing dang bud shing bstan pa dang / bsreg pa'i rdzas dang / thab khung la byug pa bya zhing mtshan ma dri ba dang / mchod pa dang / sgrub pa po'i chas gos sngon du song nas phyogs dang dus kyi shis pa dang /

ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par dang / sbyin sreg gi me lha'i khyad par dang / sbyin sreg gi me lha'i phan yon dang / bsrung ba dang / gshegs su gsol zhing rang la bsrung ba'o/ /dang po ni/ dbang ni zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyogs dang mthun pa'i sa phyogs sam/ /zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ der ni stegs bu khru brgyad pa/ /zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa ni/ tha ma mchog gi khyad par las/ /zhes sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ me tog 'bras bu dmar po'am/ /zhes sogs so/ /drug pa ni/ de nas thab khung dmar po la/ /zhes sogs so/ /bdun pa ni/ me tog dmar po la sogs pas/ /zhes sogs so/ /brgyad pa ni/ dpal ldan gos dang phreng ba dang / /zhes sogs so/ /dgu pa ni/ padma dmar po'i gdan bsams la/ /zhes sogs so/ /bcu pa ni/ mda' dang gzhu thogs de bzhin du/ /zhes sogs so/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ las byed pa ni gang yin pa/ /zhes sogs so/ /bcu gnyis pa ni/ las rnams zin par gyur pa dang / /zhes sogs so/ /bcu gsum pa ni/ de nas rdo rje 'dod pa yis/ /zhes sogs so/ /bzhi pa rjes su yi rang ba la bdun te/ gang gis bstod pa dang / mchod pa dang / bstod pa'i yul dang / bsam pa dang / bstod pa'i tshig dang / bstod pa'i phan yon dang / rjes su yi rang ba dngos so/ /dang po ni/ de nas brgya byin tshangs sogs lha/ /zhes sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ yang dang yang du ste zhes sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ phyag na rdo rje rgyal spyan la/ /zhes pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ dga' ba'i bsam pas bstod byed pa/ /zhes sogs so/ /lnga pa ni/ sems dpa' bcu drug gi sgo nas mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad du sbyar ba la/ dang po rdo rje sems dpa'i sgo nas mtshan bcu ni/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas/ /zhes sogs so/ /rdo rje rgyal po'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ rdo rje yan lag sogs so/ /rdo rje chags pa'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ phyag na rdo rje sogs so/ /rdo rje legs pa'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/

rdo rje padma sogs so/ /rdo rje las kyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ rdo rje rgyu sogs so/ /rdo rje srung ba'i sgo nas mtshan brgyad ni/ rdo rje 'jigs pa sogs so/ /rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sgo nas mtshan dgu ni/ rdo rje gnod sbyin sogs so/ /rdo rje khu tshur gyi sgo nas mtshan bdun ni/ bsgrub dka' sogs so/ /rdo rje rin chen gyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ 'od stug pa ni zhes sogs so/ /rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan sogs so/ /rdo rje gzi brjid kyi sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ sgra chen zhing ni sogs so/ /rdo rje bzhad pa'i sgo nas mtshan drug ni/ glog bzhin sogs so/ /rdo rje chos kyi sgo nas mtshan bdun ni/ spyan dmar sogs so/ /rdo rje rnon po'i sgo nas mtshan lnga ni/ 'khyil zhing sogs so/ /rdo rje 'khor lo'i sgo nas mtshan bzhi ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang srid mthar mdzad/ /sogs so/ /rdo rje smra ba'i sgo nas mtshan bzhi ni/ srid dang srid min rnam sbyong ba/ /sogs so/ /de ltar mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad po su la ldan na/ rdo rje rab skyes rdo rje sems/ /sogs so/ /drug pa ni/ gang gis 'di bris bklags gyur tam/ /sogs so/ /bdun pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /sogs so/ /brtag pa phyi ma'i tshig don rgyas par gzhan du 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang mdzad pa mtshungs pa'i rgyud rgyal 'di/ /rin chen bzang po'i gsung gi rjes 'brang sa skya pa'i/ /bzhed pa ji bzhin dam pa'i gsung la brten nas ni/ /bdag dang skal ba mnyam pa gzhan la'ang phan phyir bshad/ /byis blos rgyud don rang dgar 'grel bar mi nus shing / /sngon med gtam gyis gdul bya bslu bar 'dod min yang / /'khrul zad gong ma'i gsung gi cha shas go rim bzhin/ /legs par bkod la nyes par 'gyur ba med snyam sems/ /'di sbyar dge tshogs mdzod spu'i 'od ltar dkar ba yis/

/rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i ngan song kun zhi nas/ /theg chen lus bzang thob ste dpag med sprul pa yis/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi dga' tshal kun tu gang bar shog /ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po'i rnam par bshad pa gzhan phan kun khyab ces bya ba 'di ni/ bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs pa mtha' dag gi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa rje btsun mkhas pa'i dbang po kun dga' bzang po dang / nges don gyi zab mo'i gnad phyin ci ma log par ston pa la 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba mtshungs med dkon mchog rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la sogs pa yongs 'dzin du ma'i zhabs rdul spyi bos blangs pa la brten nas sde snod dang rgyud sde'i don la blo kha cung zad phyogs pa shākya'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges mkhas grub chen po g.yag gi dngos slob mkhan chen blo gros dpal bzang po'i gsung gis bskul zhing / rang gi slob ma du mas nye bar bskul ba'i ngor/ sa mo glang gi lo smin drug zla ba'i yar gyi ngo la dpal e waṃ chos ldan du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni mdo khams pa 'od zer bzang po dang / la stod pa gzhon nu bzang pos bgyis so/ /dge ba 'di yis dus gsum gyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod/ /bla med mchog gi bstan pa ni/ /dar rgyas yun du 'bar gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 94 kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/ sangs rgyas gzi brjid kyi rgyal po'i brtag pa'i rnam par bshad pa gzhan phan kun khyab/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 93
